2607class Value {
2608 DocumentState *doc_ = nullptr;
2609 uint32_t idx_ = 0;
2610
2611public:
2612 Value() = default;
2613 Value(DocumentState *state, uint32_t idx) : doc_(state), idx_(idx) {
2614 if (doc_)
2615 doc_->ref();
2616 }
2617 Value(DocumentView handle, uint32_t idx) : doc_(handle.state()), idx_(idx) {
2618 if (doc_)
2619 doc_->ref();
2620 }
2621 ~Value() {
2622 if (doc_)
2623 doc_->deref();
2624 }
2625 Value(const Value &o) : doc_(o.doc_), idx_(o.idx_) {
2626 if (doc_)
2627 doc_->ref();
2628 }
2629 Value &operator=(const Value &o) {
2630 if (this != &o) {
2631 if (doc_)
2632 doc_->deref();
2633 doc_ = o.doc_;
2634 idx_ = o.idx_;
2635 if (doc_)
2636 doc_->ref();
2637 }
2638 return *this;
2639 }
2640 Value(Value &&o) noexcept : doc_(o.doc_), idx_(o.idx_) { o.doc_ = nullptr; }
2641 Value &operator=(Value &&o) noexcept {
2642 if (this != &o) {
2643 if (doc_)
2644 doc_->deref();
2645 doc_ = o.doc_;
2646 idx_ = o.idx_;
2647 o.doc_ = nullptr;
2648 }
2649 return *this;
2650 }
2651
2652 // ── Internal: effective type after mutations ──────────────────────────────
2653
2654private:
2655 TapeNodeType effective_type_() const noexcept {
2656 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_))
2657 return TapeNodeType::Null;
2658 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(idx_)))
2659 return TapeNodeType::Null;
2660 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
2661 auto it = doc_->mutations_.find(idx_);
2662 if (it != doc_->mutations_.end())
2663 return it->second.type;
2664 }
2665 return doc_->tape[idx_].type();
2666 }
2667
2668public:
2669 // ── Type checkers
2670
2673 bool is_valid() const noexcept { return doc_ != nullptr; }
2674
2675 bool is_null() const noexcept {
2676 if (!doc_)
2677 return false;
2678 return effective_type_() == TapeNodeType::Null;
2679 }
2680 bool is_bool() const noexcept {
2681 if (!doc_)
2682 return false;
2683 const auto t = effective_type_();
2684 return t == TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue || t == TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse;
2685 }
2686 bool is_int() const noexcept {
2687 if (!doc_)
2688 return false;
2689 return effective_type_() == TapeNodeType::Integer;
2690 }
2691 bool is_double() const noexcept {
2692 if (!doc_)
2693 return false;
2694 const auto t = effective_type_();
2695 return t == TapeNodeType::Double || t == TapeNodeType::NumberRaw;
2696 }
2697 bool is_number() const noexcept {
2698 if (!doc_)
2699 return false;
2700 const auto t = effective_type_();
2701 return t == TapeNodeType::Integer || t == TapeNodeType::Double ||
2702 t == TapeNodeType::NumberRaw;
2703 }
2704 bool is_string() const noexcept {
2705 if (!doc_)
2706 return false;
2707 return effective_type_() == TapeNodeType::StringRaw;
2708 }
2709 bool is_object() const noexcept {
2710 if (!doc_)
2711 return false;
2712 return effective_type_() == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart;
2713 }
2714 bool is_array() const noexcept {
2715 if (!doc_)
2716 return false;
2717 return effective_type_() == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart;
2718 }
2719
2721 TapeNodeType type() const noexcept { return effective_type_(); }
2722
2724 uint32_t index() const noexcept { return idx_; }
2725
2727 DocumentState *state() const noexcept { return doc_; }
2728
2729 // ── set<T>(): write / mutate a value
2730 //
2731 // Replaces the value at this tape position with a new value.
2732 // The mutation is stored in doc_->mutations_ (overlay map).
2733 // Subsequent as<T>(), type checkers, and dump() reflect the mutation.
2734 //
2735 // Structural mutations (object keys, array elements) are not supported here
2736 // — set() targets scalar replacement at an existing tape position.
2737
2738 void set(std::nullptr_t) {
2739 if (!doc_)
2740 return;
2741 doc_->mutations_[idx_] = {TapeNodeType::Null, {}};
2742 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0; // invalidate size cache
2743 }
2744
2745 void set(bool b) {
2746 if (!doc_)
2747 return;
2748 doc_->mutations_[idx_] = {
2749 b ? TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue : TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse, {}};
2750 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
2751 }
2752
2753 template <JsonInteger T> void set(T val) {
2754 if (!doc_)
2755 return;
2756 char buf[24];
2757 // Dispatch on signedness so unsigned values above INT64_MAX serialize
2758 // correctly (static_cast<int64_t>(UINT64_MAX) would emit "-1").
2759 char *ptr = std::is_unsigned_v<T>
2760 ? detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<uint64_t>(val))
2761 : detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<int64_t>(val));
2762 doc_->mutations_[idx_] = {TapeNodeType::Integer, std::string(buf, ptr)};
2763 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
2764 }
2765
2766 template <JsonFloat T> void set(T val) {
2767 if (!doc_)
2768 return;
2769 char buf[40];
2770 char *ptr = detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<double>(val));
2771 doc_->mutations_[idx_] = {TapeNodeType::Double, std::string(buf, ptr)};
2772 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
2773 }
2774
2775 void set(std::string_view s) {
2776 if (!doc_)
2777 return;
2778 doc_->mutations_[idx_] = {TapeNodeType::StringRaw, std::string(s)};
2779 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
2780 }
2781 void set(const std::string &s) { set(std::string_view(s)); }
2782 void set(const char *s) { set(std::string_view(s)); }
2783
2784 // unset() — undo a previous set() and revert to the original parsed value.
2785 //
2786 // Removes the mutation overlay for this tape position so that subsequent
2787 // reads (as<T>(), type_name(), dump()) return the value that was present
2788 // in the original parsed JSON.
2789 //
2790 // Important: this is NOT a "reset to null". After unset():
2791 // - type_name() reflects the *original* parsed type (e.g. still "bool"
2792 // if the parsed value was a boolean)
2793 // - as<T>() returns the original parsed value
2794 //
2795 // unset() only affects the scalar mutation overlay (mutations_). Keys
2796 // added via insert() or elements added via push_back() are unaffected.
2797 // On an invalid Value (doc_=nullptr) this is a no-op.
2798 void unset() {
2799 if (!doc_)
2800 return;
2801 doc_->mutations_.erase(idx_);
2802 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
2803 }
2804
2805 // ── operator= write overloads ─────────────────────────────────────────────
2806 //
2807 // Enables: root["key"] = 42; root["arr"][0] = "text";
2808 // Each overload delegates to set() and returns *this for chaining.
2809 // The compiler-generated copy assignment (Value& = const Value&) is
2810 // retained for view-copy semantics (root["x"] = other_value_ref).
2811
2812 Value &operator=(std::nullptr_t) {
2813 set(nullptr);
2814 return *this;
2815 }
2816 Value &operator=(bool b) {
2817 set(b);
2818 return *this;
2819 }
2820 Value &operator=(const char *s) {
2821 set(s);
2822 return *this;
2823 }
2824 Value &operator=(std::string_view s) {
2825 set(s);
2826 return *this;
2827 }
2828 Value &operator=(const std::string &s) {
2829 set(s);
2830 return *this;
2831 }
2832
2833 template <JsonInteger T> Value &operator=(T val) {
2834 set(val);
2835 return *this;
2836 }
2837
2838 template <JsonFloat T> Value &operator=(T val) {
2839 set(val);
2840 return *this;
2841 }
2842
2843 // ── Safe optional-chain access ────────────────────────────────────────────
2844 //
2845 // get(key/idx) starts — or continues — an optional chain. The return
2846 // type is SafeValue (defined below), which propagates std::nullopt
2847 // silently through every subsequent operator[] so the chain NEVER throws.
2848 //
2849 // Usage:
2850 // auto id = root.get("user")["id"].as<int>(); // std::optional<int>
2851 // int id = root.get("user")["id"].value_or(-1); // int with default
2852 //
2853 // These are declared here and defined out-of-line after SafeValue.
2854 SafeValue get(std::string_view key) const noexcept;
2855 SafeValue get(const char *key) const noexcept;
2856 SafeValue get(size_t idx) const noexcept;
2857 SafeValue get(int idx) const noexcept;
2858
2859 // ── Internal: skip past the value at tape[idx], return next tape index ─────
2860 // O(n) walk for nested objects/arrays; O(1) for scalar types.
2861
2862private:
2863 uint32_t skip_value_(uint32_t idx) const noexcept {
2864 const uint32_t tsz = static_cast<uint32_t>(doc_->tape.size());
2865 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(idx >= tsz))
2866 return idx;
2867 const auto t = doc_->tape[idx].type();
2868 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart || t == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart) {
2869 int depth = 1;
2870 ++idx;
2871 while (depth > 0 && QBUEM_LIKELY(idx < tsz)) {
2872 const auto nt = doc_->tape[idx].type();
2873 if (nt == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart || nt == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart)
2874 ++depth;
2875 else if (nt == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd || nt == TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd)
2876 --depth;
2877 ++idx;
2878 }
2879 return idx;
2880 }
2881 return idx + 1;
2882 }
2883
2884public:
2885 // ── Navigation: operator[] and find
2886 //
2887 // qbuem-json API philosophy:
2888 // operator[](key/idx) — non-throwing: returns an invalid Value{}
2889 // (is_valid() == false) when the key or index is
2890 // absent. Use if(v) / v.is_valid() to check.
2891 // Use find() when you need an explicit optional.
2892 // find(key) — returns std::optional<Value> (no-throw)
2893 //
2894 // This is our own pattern: subscript for convenient chained access, find()
2895 // for conditional access — both non-throwing and composable.
2896
2897 // const char* overload — exact match for string literals, avoids ambiguity
2898 // with built-in operator[](long, const char*) that would otherwise be
2899 // considered when Value has an implicit arithmetic conversion.
2900 Value operator[](const char *key) const {
2901 return (*this)[std::string_view(key)];
2902 }
2903
2904 // operator[] — non-throwing: returns invalid Value{} (doc_=nullptr) when
2905 // the key or index is missing instead of throwing. This enables safe chains:
2906 // auto v = root["a"]["b"]["c"]; // never throws; check with if(v)
2907 // int x = root["a"]["b"].value_or(0); // via SafeValue chain
2908 //
2909 // Duplicate keys: RFC 8259 §4 permits them ("names SHOULD be unique"). When
2910 // an object contains the same key twice, this DOM lookup returns the FIRST
2911 // occurrence (first-wins). Note that the Nexus engine (fuse<T>) is LAST-wins
2912 // — it overwrites the field on each occurrence — so the two engines resolve a
2913 // duplicate differently. Both are deterministic. If duplicate keys carry
2914 // security meaning in untrusted input, reject or canonicalize upstream; do not
2915 // rely on cross-engine agreement.
2916 Value operator[](std::string_view key) const noexcept {
2917 if (!is_object())
2918 return {};
2919 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
2920 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
2921 while (i < ntape) {
2922 const auto t = doc_->tape[i].type();
2923 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd)
2924 break;
2925 // Skip deleted keys transparently
2926 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
2927 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
2928 continue;
2929 }
2930 const TapeNode &kn = doc_->tape[i];
2931 const char *kdata = doc_->source.data() + kn.offset;
2932 const size_t klen = kn.length();
2933 if (klen == key.size() && std::memcmp(kdata, key.data(), klen) == 0)
2934 return Value(doc_, i + 1);
2935 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
2936 }
2937 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->additions_.empty())) {
2938 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
2939 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end()) {
2940 for (const auto &p : ait->second) {
2941 if (p.first == key) {
2942 DocumentState *synth = doc_->get_synthetic(p.second);
2943 return Value(synth, 0);
2944 }
2945 }
2946 }
2947 }
2948 return {};
2949 }
2950
2951 // int overload — prevents implicit conversion of int literals through
2952 // arithmetic operator T() to ambiguous built-in subscript.
2953 Value operator[](int index) const noexcept {
2954 if (index < 0)
2955 return {};
2956 return (*this)[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
2957 }
2958 // unsigned int overload — resolves ambiguity between int and size_t
2959 Value operator[](unsigned int index) const noexcept {
2960 return (*this)[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
2961 }
2962
2963 Value operator[](size_t index) const noexcept {
2964 if (!is_array())
2965 return {};
2966 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
2967 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
2968 size_t count = 0;
2969 while (i < ntape) {
2970 const auto t = doc_->tape[i].type();
2971 if (t == TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd)
2972 break;
2973 // Skip deleted elements transparently
2974 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
2975 i = skip_value_(i);
2976 continue;
2977 }
2978 if (count == index)
2979 return Value(doc_, i);
2980 i = skip_value_(i);
2981 ++count;
2982 }
2983
2984 // Check array_insertions_
2985 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->array_insertions_.empty())) {
2986 auto iit = doc_->array_insertions_.find(idx_);
2987 if (iit != doc_->array_insertions_.end()) {
2988 for (const auto &ins : iit->second) {
2989 if (ins.index == index) {
2990 DocumentState *synth = doc_->get_synthetic(ins.data);
2991 return Value(synth, 0);
2992 }
2993 }
2994 }
2995 }
2996 return {};
2997 }
2998
2999 // find() — returns optional<Value>; respects deleted keys.
3000 std::optional<Value> find(std::string_view key) const noexcept {
3001 if (!is_object())
3002 return std::nullopt;
3003 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
3004 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3005 while (i < ntape) {
3006 const auto t = doc_->tape[i].type();
3007 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd)
3008 break;
3009 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
3010 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
3011 continue;
3012 }
3013 const TapeNode &kn = doc_->tape[i];
3014 const char *kdata = doc_->source.data() + kn.offset;
3015 const size_t klen = kn.length();
3016 if (klen == key.size() && std::memcmp(kdata, key.data(), klen) == 0)
3017 return Value(doc_, i + 1);
3018 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
3019 }
3020 // Key not found in tape, check additions_
3021 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->additions_.empty())) {
3022 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
3023 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end()) {
3024 for (const auto &p : ait->second) {
3025 if (p.first == key) {
3026 DocumentState *synth = doc_->get_synthetic(p.second);
3027 return Value(synth, 0);
3028 }
3029 }
3030 }
3031 }
3032 return std::nullopt;
3033 }
3034
3035 // ── Size (respects deletions + additions) ──────────────────────────────────
3036
3037 size_t size() const noexcept {
3038 if (!doc_)
3039 return 0;
3040 const auto t = doc_->tape[idx_].type();
3041 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3042 if (t == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart) {
3043 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
3044 size_t count = 0;
3045 while (i < ntape && doc_->tape[i].type() != TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd) {
3046 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() &&
3047 doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
3048 i = skip_value_(i);
3049 } else {
3050 i = skip_value_(i);
3051 ++count;
3052 }
3053 }
3054 if (!doc_->array_insertions_.empty()) {
3055 auto iit = doc_->array_insertions_.find(idx_);
3056 if (iit != doc_->array_insertions_.end())
3057 count += iit->second.size();
3058 }
3059 // push_back() appends to additions_; count those too
3060 if (!doc_->additions_.empty()) {
3061 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
3062 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end())
3063 count += ait->second.size();
3064 }
3065 return count;
3066 }
3067 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart) {
3068 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
3069 size_t count = 0;
3070 while (i < ntape && doc_->tape[i].type() != TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd) {
3071 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() &&
3072 doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
3073 i = skip_value_(i + 1); // skip deleted key+value
3074 } else {
3075 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
3076 ++count;
3077 }
3078 }
3079 if (!doc_->additions_.empty()) {
3080 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
3081 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end())
3082 count += ait->second.size();
3083 }
3084 return count;
3085 }
3086 return 0;
3087 }
3088
3089 bool empty() const noexcept { return size() == 0; }
3090
3091 // ── as<T>(): typed value extraction
3092 //
3093 // qbuem-json unique pattern: as<T>() is the single canonical accessor.
3094 // Throws std::runtime_error on type mismatch.
3095 // try_as<T>() is the non-throwing variant, returning std::optional<T>.
3096 //
3097 // Supported types:
3098 // bool, int64_t (+ all integral types via cast), double (+ float),
3099 // std::string, std::string_view
3100
3101 template <typename T> T as() const {
3102 if (!doc_ || (!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(idx_)))
3103 throw std::runtime_error(
3104 "qbuem::Value::as: value is missing, invalid, or deleted");
3105
3106 // Check mutation overlay first — O(1) unordered_map lookup, only paid
3107 // when mutations_ is non-empty (guarded by QBUEM_UNLIKELY branch).
3108 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
3109 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(idx_);
3110 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
3111 const MutationEntry &m = mit->second;
3112 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>) {
3113 if (m.type == TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue)
3114 return true;
3115 if (m.type == TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse)
3116 return false;
3117 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<bool>: not a boolean");
3118 } else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) {
3119 if (m.type != TapeNodeType::Integer)
3120 throw std::runtime_error(
3121 "qbuem::Value::as<integral>: not an integer");
3122 return detail::to_integral_checked<T>(
3123 m.data.data(), m.data.data() + m.data.size());
3124 } else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
3125 if (m.type != TapeNodeType::Double && m.type != TapeNodeType::Integer)
3126 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<float>: not a number");
3127 const char *beg = m.data.data();
3128 const char *end = beg + m.data.size();
3129 double val = detail::qj_nc::parse_f64(beg, end);
3130 return static_cast<T>(val);
3131 } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string_view>) {
3132 if (m.type != TapeNodeType::StringRaw)
3133 throw std::runtime_error(
3134 "qbuem::Value::as<string_view>: not a string");
3135 return std::string_view(m.data);
3136 } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string>) {
3137 if (m.type != TapeNodeType::StringRaw)
3138 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<string>: not a string");
3139 return m.data;
3140 }
3141 }
3142 }
3143
3144 // No mutation — read from tape (original fast path)
3145 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>) {
3146 const auto t = doc_->tape[idx_].type();
3147 if (t == TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue)
3148 return true;
3149 if (t == TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse)
3150 return false;
3151 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<bool>: not a boolean");
3152 } else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) {
3153 const auto t = doc_->tape[idx_].type();
3154 if (t != TapeNodeType::Integer && t != TapeNodeType::NumberRaw)
3155 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<integral>: not an integer");
3156 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[idx_];
3157 const char *beg = doc_->source.data() + nd.offset;
3158 const char *end = beg + nd.length();
3159 return detail::to_integral_checked<T>(beg, end);
3160 } else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
3161 const auto t = doc_->tape[idx_].type();
3162 if (t != TapeNodeType::Double && t != TapeNodeType::NumberRaw &&
3163 t != TapeNodeType::Integer)
3164 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<float>: not a number");
3165 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[idx_];
3166 const char *beg = doc_->source.data() + nd.offset;
3167 const char *end = beg + nd.length();
3168 double val = detail::qj_nc::parse_f64(beg, end);
3169 return static_cast<T>(val);
3170 } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string_view>) {
3171 // NOTE: returns the RAW on-the-wire bytes between the quotes — escape
3172 // sequences (\n, \", \uXXXX, …) are NOT decoded (this is a zero-copy view
3173 // into the source). Use decoded() if you need the logical string value.
3174 if (doc_->tape[idx_].type() != TapeNodeType::StringRaw)
3175 throw std::runtime_error("qbuem::Value::as<string_view>: not a string");
3176 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[idx_];
3177 return std::string_view(doc_->source.data() + nd.offset, nd.length());
3178 } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string>) {
3179 // Like as<string_view>, RAW (un-decoded) bytes — just owned. Use
3180 // decoded() for the unescaped logical value.
3181 return std::string(as<std::string_view>());
3182 } else {
3183 static_assert(sizeof(T) == 0, "qbuem::Value::as<T>: unsupported type");
3184 }
3185 }
3186
3187 // decoded(): the logical string value with JSON escape sequences DECODED
3188 // (\" \\ \/ \b \f \n \r \t and \uXXXX, including surrogate pairs → UTF-8).
3189 // Unlike as<std::string>() (which returns the raw on-the-wire slice), this
3190 // returns what the JSON string actually denotes. Throws if the value is not
3191 // a string. O(n), allocates.
3192 [[nodiscard]] std::string decoded() const {
3193 std::string_view raw = as<std::string_view>();
3194 return detail::json_unescape(raw);
3195 }
3196
3197 // try_as<T>(): non-throwing variant — returns std::nullopt on any error.
3198 // Constrained to JsonReadable types; ill-formed for unsupported T.
3199 template <JsonReadable T> std::optional<T> try_as() const noexcept {
3200 try {
3201 return as<T>();
3202 } catch (...) {
3203 return std::nullopt;
3204 }
3205 }
3206
3207 // ── Implicit conversion
3208 //
3209 // Enables: int age = doc["age"]; std::string name = doc["name"];
3210 // Restricted to arithmetic types and std::string/string_view to prevent
3211 // accidental conversions.
3212
3213 template <JsonReadable T> operator T() const { return as<T>(); }
3214
3215 // ── Null / validity check
3216
3217 explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return doc_ != nullptr; }
3218
3219 // ── Serialization ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3220 //
3221 // dump() — compact JSON string for this value (subtree only)
3222 // dump(string&) — buffer-reuse variant
3223 // dump(int indent) — pretty-printed with 'indent' spaces per level
3224 //
3225 // flat-buffer rewrite.
3226 // Instead of 3 × std::string::append per token (with bounds-check +
3227 // size-update overhead on every call), we pre-allocate a raw char buffer
3228 // and write directly via a pointer. The buffer is large enough to hold
3229 // compact JSON that is never larger than the pretty-printed source.
3230 // At the end we create one std::string from the exact byte count.
3231 //
3232 // Separator logic uses three 64-bit bit-stacks (max depth 64, sufficient
3233 // for all real JSON). All state lives in CPU registers — no stack arrays.
3234 // obj_bits — bit (top): depth is an object (clear = array)
3235 // key_bits — bit (top): next element in object is a key
3236 // sep_bits — bit (top): separator needed (has ≥1 element already)
3237 // Replaces four bool[1024] arrays (4 KB stack) with 24 bytes.
3238 std::string dump() const {
3239 if (!doc_ || doc_->tape.size() == 0)
3240 return "null";
3241 // Delegate to structural dump when deletions/additions are present
3242 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() || !doc_->additions_.empty() ||
3243 !doc_->array_insertions_.empty()))
3244 return dump_changes_();
3245 // Subtree (non-root): use separate path to avoid polluting the hot loop
3246 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(idx_ != 0))
3247 return dump_subtree_();
3248 const char *src = doc_->source.data();
3249 [[maybe_unused]] const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
3250 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3251
3252 // separators pre-computed by parser into meta bits 23-16.
3253 // sep == 0x00 → no separator sep == 0x01 → comma sep == 0x02 → colon
3254 // Hot path: root dump (idx_==0) — original loop, zero extra overhead.
3255 size_t mutation_extra = 0;
3256 for (const auto &[k, m] : doc_->mutations_)
3257 mutation_extra += m.data.size() * 6 + 16; // *6: worst-case escape growth
3258 // Account for per-token overhead (quotes, colons, commas) + safety margin
3259 const size_t buf_cap = doc_->source.size() + (ntape * 2) + 64 + mutation_extra;
3260 std::string out;
3261 out.resize(buf_cap);
3262 char *w = out.data();
3263 char *w0 = w;
3264
3265 for (size_t i = 0; i < ntape; ++i) {
3266 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[i];
3267 const uint32_t meta = nd.meta;
3268 const auto type = static_cast<TapeNodeType>((meta >> 24) & 0xFF);
3269 const uint8_t sep = (meta >> 16) & 0xFFu;
3270
3271 // Write pre-computed separator (branch-free for common case)
3272 // attempt (sep-per-case + StringRaw batch write) REVERTED:
3273 // moving sep write inside each switch case changed the LTO code layout,
3274 // causing citm parse to regress from +21% to +4.5% vs yyjson.
3275 // Root cause: same PGO/LTO cross-contamination pattern as /66-B.
3276 // The serialize loop and parse code share one LTO unit — any structural
3277 // change to the serialize switch affects parse I-cache layout.
3278 // branchless sep write — table lookup + conditional advance.
3279 // sep=0 writes '\0' harmlessly; switch case always overwrites it.
3280 // Saves 2 instructions + eliminates 1 branch vs conditional write.
3281#if QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3282 {
3283 static constexpr char kSepChars[3] = {'\0', ',', ':'};
3284 *w = kSepChars[sep];
3285 w += static_cast<size_t>(sep != 0);
3286 }
3287#else
3288 if (sep)
3289 *w++ = (sep == 0x02u) ? ':' : ',';
3290#endif
3291
3292 // Mutation overlay — only paid when mutations_ non-empty (rare path).
3293 // Separator already written above; write mutated scalar and skip switch.
3294 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
3295 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(static_cast<uint32_t>(i));
3296 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
3297 const MutationEntry &m = mit->second;
3298 switch (m.type) {
3299 case TapeNodeType::Null:
3300 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
3301 w += 4;
3302 break;
3303 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
3304 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
3305 w += 4;
3306 break;
3307 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
3308 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
3309 w += 5;
3310 break;
3311 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw:
3312 *w++ = '"';
3313 w = write_escaped_(w, m.data); // escape user-set string content
3314 *w++ = '"';
3315 break;
3316 default: // Integer, Double
3317 std::memcpy(w, m.data.data(), m.data.size());
3318 w += m.data.size();
3319 break;
3320 }
3321 continue;
3322 }
3323 }
3324
3325 switch (type) {
3326
3327 case TapeNodeType::ObjectStart:
3328 *w++ = '{';
3329 break;
3330 case TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd:
3331 *w++ = '}';
3332 break;
3333 case TapeNodeType::ArrayStart:
3334 *w++ = '[';
3335 break;
3336 case TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd:
3337 *w++ = ']';
3338 break;
3339
3340 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw: {
3341 const uint16_t slen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
3342 const char *sp = src + nd.offset;
3343 *w++ = '"';
3344#if QBUEM_HAS_NEON
3345 // NEON overlapping-pair copy for 17–31-byte strings.
3346 // For slen in [17,31]: two 16B VLD1Q+VST1Q stores cover all bytes.
3347 // Store 1: w[0..15] (first 16B of string)
3348 // Store 2: w[slen-16..slen-1] (last 16B of string, overlaps)
3349 // The overlap region is written twice with identical data — correct.
3350 // Source read: sp+slen-16 ≤ sp+15 < sp+slen (closing '"') — in-bounds.
3351 // Eliminates the 16B+cascade branch chain for 96%+ of twitter strings.
3352 //
3353 // For slen ≤ 16: scalar 8-4-1 cascade (fast for short keys).
3354 // For slen ≥ 32: std::memcpy (large values, dispatch overhead
3355 // amortised). : Restructured branch order — slen 1-16 (95%+
3356 // of citm/twitter) checked FIRST → 2 branches in hot path vs 3 (saves 1
3357 // branch/string). Code size: ~13 instructions vs ~16 → smaller hot-path
3358 // I-cache footprint. Generic NEON (non-M1): structure
3359 // unchanged.
3360#if QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3361 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 16)) {
3362 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(sp + 16 <= src + src_sz)) {
3363 vst1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w),
3364 vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp)));
3365 w += slen;
3366 } else {
3367 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3368 w += slen;
3369 }
3370 } else if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3371 const uint8_t *up = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp);
3372 uint8_t *uw = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w);
3373 vst1q_u8(uw, vld1q_u8(up));
3374 vst1q_u8(uw + slen - 16, vld1q_u8(up + slen - 16));
3375 w += slen;
3376 } else {
3377 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3378 w += slen;
3379 }
3380#else // generic NEON (non-Apple-Silicon): structure
3381 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3382 if (slen >= 17) {
3383 const uint8_t *up = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp);
3384 uint8_t *uw = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w);
3385 vst1q_u8(uw, vld1q_u8(up));
3386 vst1q_u8(uw + slen - 16, vld1q_u8(up + slen - 16));
3387 w += slen;
3388 } else {
3389 uint16_t rem = slen;
3390 if (rem >= 16) {
3391 uint64_t a, b;
3392 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3393 std::memcpy(&b, sp + 8, 8);
3394 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3395 std::memcpy(w + 8, &b, 8);
3396 sp += 16;
3397 w += 16;
3398 rem = 0;
3399 }
3400 if (rem >= 8) {
3401 uint64_t a;
3402 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3403 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3404 sp += 8;
3405 w += 8;
3406 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 8);
3407 }
3408 if (rem >= 4) {
3409 uint32_t a;
3410 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 4);
3411 std::memcpy(w, &a, 4);
3412 sp += 4;
3413 w += 4;
3414 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 4);
3415 }
3416 while (rem--)
3417 *w++ = *sp++;
3418 }
3419 } else {
3420 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3421 w += slen;
3422 }
3423#endif // QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3424#else
3425 // Unrolled 16-8-4-1 copy: avoids glibc dispatch overhead
3426 // for short strings (twitter.json avg 16.9 chars, 84% ≤ 24 chars).
3427 // attempt: SSE2 overlapping-pair for 17–31B was REVERTED.
3428 // The SSE2 stores altered the PGO profile (LTO cross-contamination),
3429 // causing citm parse to regress +14% (598→684μs) for only −5% serialize
3430 // gain. Scalar 16-8-4-1 preserves parse performance.
3431 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3432 uint16_t rem = slen;
3433 if (rem >= 16) {
3434 uint64_t a, b;
3435 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3436 std::memcpy(&b, sp + 8, 8);
3437 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3438 std::memcpy(w + 8, &b, 8);
3439 sp += 16;
3440 w += 16;
3441 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 16);
3442 }
3443 if (rem >= 8) {
3444 uint64_t a;
3445 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3446 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3447 sp += 8;
3448 w += 8;
3449 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 8);
3450 }
3451 if (rem >= 4) {
3452 uint32_t a;
3453 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 4);
3454 std::memcpy(w, &a, 4);
3455 sp += 4;
3456 w += 4;
3457 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 4);
3458 }
3459 while (rem--)
3460 *w++ = *sp++;
3461 } else {
3462 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3463 w += slen;
3464 }
3465#endif // QBUEM_HAS_NEON
3466 *w++ = '"';
3467 break;
3468 }
3469
3470 case TapeNodeType::Integer:
3471 case TapeNodeType::NumberRaw:
3472 case TapeNodeType::Double: {
3473 const uint16_t nlen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
3474 std::memcpy(w, src + nd.offset, nlen);
3475 w += nlen;
3476 break;
3477 }
3478
3479 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
3480 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
3481 w += 4;
3482 break;
3483 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
3484 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
3485 w += 5;
3486 break;
3487 case TapeNodeType::Null:
3488 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
3489 w += 4;
3490 break;
3491
3492 default:
3493 break;
3494 }
3495 }
3496
3497 out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(w - w0));
3498 return out;
3499 }

3501 // Buffer-reuse dump() overload.
3502 //
3503 // Serializes into a caller-provided std::string, amortising malloc+free
3504 // across repeated calls on the same document (streaming, hot loops).
3505 //
3506 // Usage:
3507 // std::string buf;
3508 // for (...) { root.dump(buf); process(buf); }
3509 //
3510 // uses last_dump_size_ to resize to the exact output size from
3511 // the previous call instead of buf_cap. For a fixed document the output
3512 // size is constant, so resize(last_dump_size_) is a no-op on the 2nd+
3513 // call (out.size() already equals last_dump_size_) — zero zero-fill cost.
3514 // The first call still uses buf_cap to guarantee sufficient capacity.
3515 //
3516 // LTO safety: do NOT mark this NOINLINE. The compiler
3517 // will inline it at call sites, keeping code layout identical to dump().
3518 // NOINLINE caused parse regression on x86 PGO/LTO builds.
3519 void dump(std::string &out) const {
3520 if (!doc_ || doc_->tape.size() == 0) {
3521 out.assign("null", 4);
3522 return;
3523 }
3524 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() || !doc_->additions_.empty() ||
3525 !doc_->array_insertions_.empty())) {
3526 out = dump_changes_();
3527 return;
3528 }
3529 // Subtree (non-root): last_dump_size_ is root-only; don't use cache here
3530 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(idx_ != 0)) {
3531 out = dump_subtree_();
3532 return;
3533 }
3534 const char *src = doc_->source.data();
3535 [[maybe_unused]] const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
3536 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3537 size_t mutation_extra2 = 0;
3538 for (const auto &[k, m] : doc_->mutations_)
3539 mutation_extra2 += m.data.size() * 6 + 16; // *6: worst-case escape growth
3540 // + (ntape * 2): the relaxed parser accepts separator-less tokens, so the
3541 // compact dump can insert separators absent from the source and exceed
3542 // source.size() (matches the no-arg dump() bound; prevents overflow).
3543 const size_t buf_cap =
3544 doc_->source.size() + (ntape * 2) + 64 + mutation_extra2;
3545
3546 // last_dump_size_ cache — root-only (avoids cross-contamination
3547 // with subtree dump sizes which would undersize the buffer and overflow).
3548 const size_t target =
3549 (doc_->last_dump_size_ > 0) ? doc_->last_dump_size_ : buf_cap;
3550 out.resize(target);
3551 char *w = out.data();
3552 char *w0 = w;
3553
3554 for (size_t i = 0; i < ntape; ++i) {
3555 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[i];
3556 const uint32_t meta = nd.meta;
3557 const auto type = static_cast<TapeNodeType>((meta >> 24) & 0xFF);
3558 const uint8_t sep = (meta >> 16) & 0xFFu;
3559
3560#if QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3561 {
3562 static constexpr char kSepChars[3] = {'\0', ',', ':'};
3563 *w = kSepChars[sep];
3564 w += static_cast<size_t>(sep != 0);
3565 }
3566#else
3567 if (sep)
3568 *w++ = (sep == 0x02u) ? ':' : ',';
3569#endif
3570
3571 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
3572 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(static_cast<uint32_t>(i));
3573 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
3574 const MutationEntry &m = mit->second;
3575 switch (m.type) {
3576 case TapeNodeType::Null:
3577 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
3578 w += 4;
3579 break;
3580 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
3581 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
3582 w += 4;
3583 break;
3584 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
3585 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
3586 w += 5;
3587 break;
3588 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw:
3589 *w++ = '"';
3590 w = write_escaped_(w, m.data); // escape user-set string content
3591 *w++ = '"';
3592 break;
3593 default:
3594 std::memcpy(w, m.data.data(), m.data.size());
3595 w += m.data.size();
3596 break;
3597 }
3598 continue;
3599 }
3600 }
3601
3602 switch (type) {
3603
3604 case TapeNodeType::ObjectStart:
3605 *w++ = '{';
3606 break;
3607 case TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd:
3608 *w++ = '}';
3609 break;
3610 case TapeNodeType::ArrayStart:
3611 *w++ = '[';
3612 break;
3613 case TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd:
3614 *w++ = ']';
3615 break;
3616
3617 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw: {
3618 const uint16_t slen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
3619 const char *sp = src + nd.offset;
3620 *w++ = '"';
3621#if QBUEM_HAS_NEON
3622 // see dump() above for rationale.
3623#if QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3624 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 16)) {
3625 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(sp + 16 <= src + src_sz)) {
3626 vst1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w),
3627 vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp)));
3628 w += slen;
3629 } else {
3630 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3631 w += slen;
3632 }
3633 } else if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3634 const uint8_t *up = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp);
3635 uint8_t *uw = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w);
3636 vst1q_u8(uw, vld1q_u8(up));
3637 vst1q_u8(uw + slen - 16, vld1q_u8(up + slen - 16));
3638 w += slen;
3639 } else {
3640 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3641 w += slen;
3642 }
3643#else // generic NEON (non-Apple-Silicon): structure
3644 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3645 if (slen >= 17) {
3646 const uint8_t *up = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(sp);
3647 uint8_t *uw = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(w);
3648 vst1q_u8(uw, vld1q_u8(up));
3649 vst1q_u8(uw + slen - 16, vld1q_u8(up + slen - 16));
3650 w += slen;
3651 } else {
3652 uint16_t rem = slen;
3653 if (rem >= 16) {
3654 uint64_t a, b;
3655 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3656 std::memcpy(&b, sp + 8, 8);
3657 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3658 std::memcpy(w + 8, &b, 8);
3659 sp += 16;
3660 w += 16;
3661 rem = 0;
3662 }
3663 if (rem >= 8) {
3664 uint64_t a;
3665 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3666 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3667 sp += 8;
3668 w += 8;
3669 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 8);
3670 }
3671 if (rem >= 4) {
3672 uint32_t a;
3673 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 4);
3674 std::memcpy(w, &a, 4);
3675 sp += 4;
3676 w += 4;
3677 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 4);
3678 }
3679 while (rem--)
3680 *w++ = *sp++;
3681 }
3682 } else {
3683 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3684 w += slen;
3685 }
3686#endif // QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON
3687#else
3688 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(slen <= 31)) {
3689 uint16_t rem = slen;
3690 if (rem >= 16) {
3691 uint64_t a, b;
3692 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3693 std::memcpy(&b, sp + 8, 8);
3694 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3695 std::memcpy(w + 8, &b, 8);
3696 sp += 16;
3697 w += 16;
3698 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 16);
3699 }
3700 if (rem >= 8) {
3701 uint64_t a;
3702 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 8);
3703 std::memcpy(w, &a, 8);
3704 sp += 8;
3705 w += 8;
3706 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 8);
3707 }
3708 if (rem >= 4) {
3709 uint32_t a;
3710 std::memcpy(&a, sp, 4);
3711 std::memcpy(w, &a, 4);
3712 sp += 4;
3713 w += 4;
3714 rem = static_cast<uint16_t>(rem - 4);
3715 }
3716 while (rem--)
3717 *w++ = *sp++;
3718 } else {
3719 std::memcpy(w, sp, slen);
3720 w += slen;
3721 }
3722#endif
3723 *w++ = '"';
3724 break;
3725 }
3726
3727 case TapeNodeType::Integer:
3728 case TapeNodeType::NumberRaw:
3729 case TapeNodeType::Double: {
3730 const uint16_t nlen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
3731 std::memcpy(w, src + nd.offset, nlen);
3732 w += nlen;
3733 break;
3734 }
3735
3736 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
3737 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
3738 w += 4;
3739 break;
3740 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
3741 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
3742 w += 5;
3743 break;
3744 case TapeNodeType::Null:
3745 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
3746 w += 4;
3747 break;
3748
3749 default:
3750 break;
3751 }
3752 }
3753
3754 const size_t actual = static_cast<size_t>(w - w0);
3755 out.resize(actual);
3756 doc_->last_dump_size_ = actual; // cache for zero-fill-free resize next call
3757 }

3759 // ── Pretty-print ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3760 //
3761 // dump(indent) — human-readable JSON with 'indent' spaces per level.
3762 // Uses std::string::append internally (not ultra-fast, but pretty-print
3763 // is rarely on the hot path).
3764 std::string dump(int indent) const {
3765 if (!doc_)
3766 return "null";
3767 std::string out;
3768 out.reserve(doc_->source.size() * 2 + 64);
3769 dump_pretty_(out, indent, 0);
3770 return out;
3771 }
3772
3773 // ── Structural modification ───────────────────────────────────────────────
3774 //
3775 // erase(key) — delete an object key + its entire value subtree
3776 // erase(idx) — delete an array element
3777 // insert(key, val) — add a key-value pair to an object
3778 // push_back(val) — append an element to an array
3779 //
3780 // All operations are reflected immediately by dump(), operator[], find(),
3781 // size(), items(), and elements().
3782
3783 bool erase(std::string_view key) {
3784 if (!is_object())
3785 return false;
3786 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
3787 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3788 while (i < ntape) {
3789 const auto t = doc_->tape[i].type();
3790 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd)
3791 return false;
3792 const TapeNode &kn = doc_->tape[i];
3793 const char *kdata = doc_->source.data() + kn.offset;
3794 if (kn.length() == key.size() &&
3795 std::memcmp(kdata, key.data(), key.size()) == 0) {
3796 doc_->deleted_.insert(i);
3797 uint32_t val_end = skip_value_(i + 1);
3798 for (uint32_t k = i + 1; k < val_end; ++k)
3799 doc_->deleted_.insert(k);
3800 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
3801 return true;
3802 }
3803 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
3804 }
3805 return false;
3806 }
3807 bool erase(const char *key) { return erase(std::string_view(key)); }
3808
3809 bool erase(size_t idx) {
3810 if (!is_array())
3811 return false;
3812 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
3813 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
3814 size_t count = 0;
3815 while (i < ntape) {
3816 const auto t = doc_->tape[i].type();
3817 if (t == TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd)
3818 return false;
3819 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i))) {
3820 i = skip_value_(i);
3821 continue;
3822 }
3823 if (count == idx) {
3824 doc_->deleted_.insert(i);
3825 uint32_t val_end = skip_value_(i);
3826 for (uint32_t k = i + 1; k < val_end; ++k)
3827 doc_->deleted_.insert(k);
3828 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
3829 return true;
3830 }
3831 i = skip_value_(i);
3832 ++count;
3833 }
3834 return false;
3835 }
3836 bool erase(int idx) {
3837 if (idx >= 0)
3838 return erase(static_cast<size_t>(idx));
3839 return false;
3840 }
3841 // unsigned int overload — resolves ambiguity between int and size_t
3842 bool erase(unsigned int idx) { return erase(static_cast<size_t>(idx)); }
3843
3844 // ── Structural insert API ────────────────────────────────────────────────
3845 //
3846 // insert(key, T) — type-safe: strings are quoted, scalars serialized
3847 // insert_json(key, sv) — raw JSON (use for nested objects/arrays)
3848 // push_back(T) — array append (type-safe)
3849 // push_back_json(sv) — raw JSON append
3850
3851 // insert_json: store a pre-serialized JSON value (raw, no quoting)
3852 void insert_json(std::string_view key, std::string_view raw_json) {
3853 if (!is_object())
3854 return;
3855 doc_->additions_[idx_].emplace_back(std::string(key),
3856 std::string(raw_json));
3857 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
3858 }
3859 // insert(key, string) — inserts a JSON string (auto-quoted)
3860 void insert(std::string_view key, std::string_view str_val) {
3861 insert_json(key, scalar_to_json_(str_val));
3862 }
3863 void insert(std::string_view key, const std::string &str_val) {
3864 insert(key, std::string_view(str_val));
3865 }
3866 void insert(std::string_view key, const char *str_val) {
3867 insert(key, std::string_view(str_val));
3868 }
3869 // insert(key, nullptr/bool) — explicit overloads
3870 void insert(std::string_view key, std::nullptr_t) {
3871 insert_json(key, "null");
3872 }
3873 void insert(std::string_view key, bool b) {
3874 insert_json(key, b ? "true" : "false");
3875 }
3876 // insert(key, numeric) — numeric scalars
3877 template <JsonInteger T> void insert(std::string_view key, T val) {
3878 insert_json(key, scalar_to_json_(val));
3879 }
3880 template <JsonFloat T> void insert(std::string_view key, T val) {
3881 insert_json(key, scalar_to_json_(val));
3882 }
3883 // insert(key, Value) — serializes the value subtree
3884 void insert(std::string_view key, const Value &v) {
3885 insert_json(key, v.dump());
3886 }
3887
3888 // push_back_json: raw JSON append
3889 void push_back_json(std::string_view raw_json) {
3890 if (!is_array())
3891 return;
3892 doc_->additions_[idx_].emplace_back(std::string(), std::string(raw_json));
3893 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
3894 }
3895 // push_back(string) — auto-quoted
3896 void push_back(std::string_view str_val) {
3897 push_back_json(scalar_to_json_(str_val));
3898 }
3899 void push_back(const std::string &str_val) {
3900 push_back(std::string_view(str_val));
3901 }
3902 void push_back(const char *str_val) { push_back(std::string_view(str_val)); }
3903 void push_back(std::nullptr_t) { push_back_json("null"); }
3904 void push_back(bool b) { push_back_json(b ? "true" : "false"); }
3905 template <JsonInteger T> void push_back(T val) {
3906 push_back_json(scalar_to_json_(val));
3907 }
3908 template <JsonFloat T> void push_back(T val) {
3909 push_back_json(scalar_to_json_(val));
3910 }
3911 void push_back(const Value &v) { push_back_json(v.dump()); }
3912
3913 // ── Iteration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
3914 //
3915 // items() — forward-iterable view over {key, value} pairs of an object.
3916 // Skips deleted keys and includes additions.
3917 // elements() — forward-iterable view over elements of an array.
3918 // Skips deleted elements.
3919 //
3920 // Usage:
3921 // for (auto [k, v] : root["obj"].items())
3922 // std::cout << k << " = " << v.dump() << "\n";
3923 //
3924 // for (auto elem : root["arr"].elements())
3925 // std::cout << elem.as<int>() << "\n";
3926
3927 // Shared skip helper — delegates to the canonical skip_value_() instance
3928 // method. Static so iterator classes (defined before their parent Value
3929 // closes) can call it.
3930 static uint32_t skip_val_s_(DocumentState *doc, uint32_t i) noexcept {
3931 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc || i >= static_cast<uint32_t>(doc->tape.size())))
3932 return i;
3933 Value tmp(doc, i);
3934 return tmp.skip_value_(i);
3935 }
3936
3937 // Forward iterator over object key-value pairs.
3938 // Yields std::pair<std::string_view, Value> — structured bindings work:
3939 // for (auto [key, val] : root["obj"].items()) { ... }
3940 // Iterates original tape keys first, then any inserted additions.
3941 class ObjectIterator {
3942 DocumentState *doc_;
3943 uint32_t key_idx_; // UINT32_MAX = tape exhausted
3944 // additions_ pointer + index for iterating inserted key-value pairs
3945 const ::std::vector<::std::pair<::std::string, ::std::string>> *adds_ =
3946 nullptr;
3947 size_t add_idx_ = ::std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max(); // max = done
3948
3949 void skip_deleted_() noexcept {
3950 // An invalid Value (doc_ == nullptr) iterates as empty — .items() on a
3951 // non-object or absent value must not deref a null doc.
3952 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_)) {
3953 key_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
3954 return;
3955 }
3956 const size_t tape_sz = doc_->tape.size();
3957 while (key_idx_ != UINT32_MAX) {
3958 // Bounds guard: malformed tape may lack an ObjectEnd sentinel.
3959 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(key_idx_ >= tape_sz)) {
3960 key_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
3961 break;
3962 }
3963 const auto t = doc_->tape[key_idx_].type();
3964 if (t == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd) {
3965 key_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
3966 break;
3967 }
3968 if (doc_->deleted_.empty() || !doc_->deleted_.count(key_idx_))
3969 return;
3970 key_idx_ = skip_val_s_(doc_, key_idx_ + 1); // skip deleted key+value
3971 }
3972 // Tape exhausted — transition to additions if available
3973 if (key_idx_ == UINT32_MAX && adds_ != nullptr)
3974 add_idx_ = 0;
3975 }
3976
3977 public:
3978 // value_type uses pair to avoid incomplete-type issue with Value inside
3979 // Value
3980 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
3981 using value_type = std::pair<std::string_view, Value>;
3982 using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;
3983
3984 // End sentinel: key_idx_=UINT32_MAX, add_idx_=SIZE_MAX
3985 ObjectIterator() noexcept
3986 : doc_(nullptr), key_idx_(UINT32_MAX), adds_(nullptr),
3987 add_idx_(::std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {}
3988 ObjectIterator(DocumentState *doc, uint32_t key_idx,
3989 const ::std::vector<::std::pair<::std::string,
3990 ::std::string>> *adds) noexcept
3991 : doc_(doc), key_idx_(key_idx), adds_(adds),
3992 add_idx_(::std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
3993 skip_deleted_();
3994 }
3995
3996 // Returns {key_string_view, Value} — Value is constructed on demand
3997 std::pair<std::string_view, Value> operator*() const noexcept {
3998 if (key_idx_ != UINT32_MAX) {
3999 // Tape entry
4000 const TapeNode &kn = doc_->tape[key_idx_];
4001 return {std::string_view(doc_->source.data() + kn.offset, kn.length()),
4002 Value(doc_, key_idx_ + 1)};
4003 }
4004 // Addition entry: parse value via synthetic document
4005 const auto &p = (*adds_)[add_idx_];
4006 DocumentState *synth = doc_->get_synthetic(p.second);
4007 return {std::string_view(p.first), Value(synth, 0)};
4008 }
4009 ObjectIterator &operator++() noexcept {
4010 if (key_idx_ != UINT32_MAX) {
4011 key_idx_ = skip_val_s_(doc_, key_idx_ + 1); // skip value
4012 skip_deleted_();
4013 } else if (adds_ != nullptr &&
4014 add_idx_ != ::std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
4015 ++add_idx_;
4016 if (add_idx_ >= adds_->size())
4017 add_idx_ = ::std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max(); // mark done
4018 }
4019 return *this;
4020 }
4021 ObjectIterator operator++(int) noexcept {
4022 auto t = *this;
4023 ++(*this);
4024 return t;
4025 }
4026 bool operator==(const ObjectIterator &o) const noexcept {
4027 return key_idx_ == o.key_idx_ && add_idx_ == o.add_idx_;
4028 }
4029 };
4030
4031 // Range-compatible proxy for object iteration (includes additions)
4032 class ObjectRange : public std::ranges::view_base {
4033 DocumentState *doc_;
4034 uint32_t obj_idx_; // ObjectStart tape index
4035 // Additions appended as synthetic entries after tape traversal
4036 const ::std::vector<::std::pair<::std::string, ::std::string>> *adds_ =
4037 nullptr;
4038
4039 public:
4040 ObjectRange(DocumentState *doc, uint32_t idx) noexcept
4041 : doc_(doc), obj_idx_(idx) {
4042 if (doc_ && !doc_->additions_.empty()) {
4043 auto it = doc_->additions_.find(idx);
4044 if (it != doc_->additions_.end())
4045 adds_ = &it->second;
4046 }
4047 }
4048 ObjectIterator begin() const noexcept {
4049 return {doc_, obj_idx_ + 1, adds_};
4050 }
4051 ObjectIterator end() const noexcept { return {}; }
4052 // additions are accessible via added_items() for legacy callers
4053 const ::std::vector<::std::pair<::std::string, ::std::string>> *
4054 added_items() const noexcept {
4055 return adds_;
4056 }
4057 };
4058
4059 // Forward iterator over array elements
4060 class ArrayIterator {
4061 DocumentState *doc_;
4062 uint32_t elem_idx_; // UINT32_MAX = end
4063 void skip_deleted_() noexcept {
4064 // An invalid Value (doc_ == nullptr) iterates as empty — e.g. .elements()
4065 // on a non-array or absent value, such as a malformed object key with no
4066 // value (`{"k"}`). Without this the constructor would deref a null doc.
4067 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_)) {
4068 elem_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
4069 return;
4070 }
4071 const size_t tape_sz = doc_->tape.size();
4072 while (elem_idx_ != UINT32_MAX) {
4073 // Bounds guard: malformed tape may lack an ArrayEnd sentinel.
4074 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(elem_idx_ >= tape_sz)) {
4075 elem_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
4076 return;
4077 }
4078 const auto t = doc_->tape[elem_idx_].type();
4079 if (t == TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd) {
4080 elem_idx_ = UINT32_MAX;
4081 return;
4082 }
4083 if (doc_->deleted_.empty() || !doc_->deleted_.count(elem_idx_))
4084 return;
4085 elem_idx_ = skip_val_s_(doc_, elem_idx_);
4086 }
4087 }
4088
4089 public:
4090 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
4091 using value_type = Value;
4092 using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;
4093
4094 ArrayIterator() noexcept : doc_(nullptr), elem_idx_(UINT32_MAX) {}
4095 ArrayIterator(DocumentState *doc, uint32_t elem_idx) noexcept
4096 : doc_(doc), elem_idx_(elem_idx) {
4097 skip_deleted_();
4098 }
4099
4100 Value operator*() const noexcept { return Value(doc_, elem_idx_); }
4101 ArrayIterator &operator++() noexcept {
4102 elem_idx_ = skip_val_s_(doc_, elem_idx_);
4103 skip_deleted_();
4104 return *this;
4105 }
4106 ArrayIterator operator++(int) noexcept {
4107 auto t = *this;
4108 ++(*this);
4109 return t;
4110 }
4111 bool operator==(const ArrayIterator &o) const noexcept {
4112 return elem_idx_ == o.elem_idx_;
4113 }
4114 };
4115
4116 class ArrayRange : public std::ranges::view_base {
4117 DocumentState *doc_;
4118 uint32_t arr_idx_;
4119
4120 public:
4121 ArrayRange(DocumentState *doc, uint32_t idx) noexcept
4122 : doc_(doc), arr_idx_(idx) {}
4123 ArrayIterator begin() const noexcept { return {doc_, arr_idx_ + 1}; }
4124 ArrayIterator end() const noexcept { return {}; }
4125 };

4127 // ── Iterator adapters for keys(), values(), as_array<T>(), try_as_array<T>()
4128 //
4129 // These avoid std::views::transform (which internally uses view_interface<D>)
4130 // to work around a GCC 12 / libstdc++12 bug where view_interface<D> eagerly
4131 // evaluates iterator_t<D> during class instantiation, creating a circular
4132 // constraint dependency that GCC 12 cannot resolve.
4133
4134 struct KeyIterator {
4135 ObjectIterator it_;
4136 using value_type = std::string_view;
4137 using reference = std::string_view;
4138 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
4139 using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;
4140 using iterator_concept = std::forward_iterator_tag;
4141 KeyIterator() noexcept = default;
4142 explicit KeyIterator(ObjectIterator it) noexcept : it_(it) {}
4143 std::string_view operator*() const noexcept { return (*it_).first; }
4144 KeyIterator &operator++() noexcept {
4145 ++it_;
4146 return *this;
4147 }
4148 KeyIterator operator++(int) noexcept {
4149 auto t = *this;
4150 ++it_;
4151 return t;
4152 }
4153 bool operator==(const KeyIterator &o) const noexcept {
4154 return it_ == o.it_;
4155 }
4156 };
4157 struct KeysRange {
4158 ObjectRange r_;
4159 explicit KeysRange(ObjectRange r) noexcept : r_(r) {}
4160 KeyIterator begin() const noexcept { return KeyIterator{r_.begin()}; }
4161 KeyIterator end() const noexcept { return KeyIterator{r_.end()}; }
4162 };
4163
4164 struct ObjectValueIterator {
4165 ObjectIterator it_;
4166 using value_type = Value;
4167 using reference = Value;
4168 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
4169 using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;

4198 template <JsonReadable T> struct TypedArrayIterator {
