4268 // ── Public type aliases for use in lambdas ──────────────────────────────
4269 //
4270 // Avoids the `template` keyword in generic lambdas over items():
4271 // for (auto kv : root.items()) { kv.second.as<int>(); } // generic lambda:
4272 // needs 'template'
4273 // [](Value::ObjectItem kv){ kv.second.as<int>(); } // explicit type:
4274 // no 'template'
4275 // [](Value::ObjectItem kv){ kv.second.as<int>(); }
4276 using ObjectItem =
4277 std::pair<std::string_view, Value>; // key-value pair from items()
4278
4279 // items() — object iteration
4280 ObjectRange items() const noexcept {
4281 if (!doc_ || !is_object())
4282 return {nullptr, 0};
4283 return {doc_, idx_};
4284 }
4285 // elements() — array iteration
4286 ArrayRange elements() const noexcept {
4287 if (!doc_ || !is_array())
4288 return {nullptr, 0};
4289 return {doc_, idx_};
4290 }
4291
4292 // ── contains(key) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4293 //
4294 // Returns true iff the object has the given key (not deleted).
4295 // Equivalent to find(key).has_value() but reads more naturally.
4296 //
4297 // Usage: if (root.contains("name")) { ... }
4298 bool contains(std::string_view key) const noexcept {
4299 return find(key).has_value();
4300 }
4301 bool contains(const char *key) const noexcept {
4302 return contains(std::string_view(key));
4303 }
4304
4305 // ── value(key/idx, default) — safe extraction with fallback ───────────────
4306 //
4307 // Returns the value at key/index, or `def` if the key is missing or the
4308 // value's type doesn't match T. Never throws.
4309 //
4310 // Usage:
4311 // int age = root.value("age", 0);
4312 // std::string name = root.value("name", "anonymous");
4313 // double x = root.value(0, 0.0); // first array element or 0.0
4314
4315 template <JsonReadable T>
4316 T value(std::string_view key, T def) const noexcept {
4317 auto opt = find(key);
4318 if (!opt)
4319 return def;
4320 auto r = opt->try_as<T>();
4321 return r ? *r : def;
4322 }
4323 template <JsonReadable T> T value(const char *key, T def) const noexcept {
4324 return value(std::string_view(key), def);
4325 }
4326 template <JsonReadable T> T value(size_t idx, T def) const noexcept {
4327 auto v = (*this)[idx];
4328 if (!v)
4329 return def;
4330 auto r = v.try_as<T>();
4331 return r ? *r : def;
4332 }
4333 template <JsonReadable T> T value(int idx, T def) const noexcept {
4334 if (idx < 0)
4335 return def;
4336 return value(static_cast<size_t>(idx), def);
4337 }
4338 // String literal specializations (const char* → std::string)
4339 std::string value(std::string_view key, const char *def) const noexcept {
4340 auto opt = find(key);
4341 if (!opt)
4342 return std::string(def);
4343 auto r = opt->try_as<std::string>();
4344 return r ? *r : std::string(def);
4345 }
4346 std::string value(const char *key, const char *def) const noexcept {
4347 return value(std::string_view(key), def);
4348 }
4349
4350 // ── type_name() — human-readable type string ──────────────────────────────
4351 //
4352 // Returns one of: "null", "bool", "int", "double", "string", "array",
4353 // "object", or "invalid" (when the Value is empty/missing).
4354 //
4355 // Usage: std::cout << root["age"].type_name() << "\n"; // "int"
4356 std::string_view type_name() const noexcept {
4357 if (!doc_)
4358 return "invalid";
4359 switch (effective_type_()) {
4360 case TapeNodeType::Null:
4361 return "null";
4362 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
4363 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
4364 return "bool";
4365 case TapeNodeType::Integer:
4366 return "int";
4367 case TapeNodeType::Double:
4368 case TapeNodeType::NumberRaw:
4369 return "double";
4370 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw:
4371 return "string";
4372 case TapeNodeType::ArrayStart:
4373 return "array";
4374 case TapeNodeType::ObjectStart:
4375 return "object";
4376 default:
4377 return "unknown";
4378 }
4379 }
4380
4381 // ── operator| — pipe fallback ─────────────────────────────────────────────
4382 //
4383 // Enables: int age = root["age"] | 42;
4384 // std::string s = root["name"] | "unknown";
4385 // double x = root["x"] | 0.0;
4386 //
4387 // Returns try_as<T>() with fallback `def` when the Value is invalid
4388 // (missing key/index) or the type doesn't match.
4389 //
4390 // Defined as non-member friend: the template version takes priority over
4391 // the built-in int|int (which would require a user-defined conversion),
4392 // so `root["age"] | 42` correctly calls this operator rather than
4393 // converting Value to int first.
4394
4395 template <JsonReadable T> friend T operator|(const Value &v, T def) noexcept {
4396 auto r = v.try_as<T>();
4397 return r ? *r : def;
4398 }
4399 friend std::string operator|(const Value &v, std::string_view def) noexcept {
4400 auto r = v.try_as<std::string>();
4401 return r ? *r : std::string(def);
4402 }
4403 friend std::string operator|(const Value &v, const char *def) noexcept {
4404 auto r = v.try_as<std::string>();
4405 return r ? *r : std::string(def);
4406 }
4407
4408 // ── keys() / values() — object key/value ranges ───────────────────────────
4409 //
4410 // DOM-based transform views over items().
4411 //
4412 // Usage:
4413 // for (std::string_view k : root.keys()) { ... }
4414 // for (qbuem::Value v : root.values()) { ... }
4415 // auto first_key = *root.keys().begin();
4416
4417 KeysRange keys() const noexcept { return KeysRange{items()}; }
4418 ValuesRange values() const noexcept { return ValuesRange{items()}; }
4419
4420 // ── as_array<T>() / try_as_array<T>() — typed element views ──────────────
4421 //
4422 // DOM-based transform view over elements() yielding each element as T.
4423 // as_array<T>() — throws std::runtime_error on type mismatch
4424 // try_as_array<T>() — yields std::optional<T>, never throws
4425 //
4426 // Usage:
4427 // for (int id : doc["ids"].as_array<int>()) { ... }
4428 // auto sum = std::accumulate(
4429 // doc["vals"].as_array<double>().begin(),
4430 // doc["vals"].as_array<double>().end(), 0.0);
4431 // for (auto maybe : doc["mixed"].try_as_array<int>())
4432 // if (maybe) total += *maybe;
4433
4434 template <JsonReadable T> TypedArrayRange<T> as_array() const {
4435 return TypedArrayRange<T>{elements()};
4436 }
4437 template <JsonReadable T>
4438 OptionalArrayRange<T> try_as_array() const noexcept {
4439 return OptionalArrayRange<T>{elements()};
4440 }
4441
4442 // ── at(path) — Runtime JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) ────────────────────────────
4443 //
4444 // Navigates nested values using a slash-delimited path.
4445 // Handles RFC 6901 escape sequences: ~1 → '/', ~0 → '~'.
4446 // Returns invalid Value{} (operator bool() == false) on any missing step.
4447 // Empty path returns *this (root).
4448 //
4449 // Usage:
4450 // root.at("/users/0/name") → "Alice"
4451 // root.at("/config/timeout") → 5000
4452 // root.at("") → root itself
4453 // root.at("/missing/path") → invalid Value{} (bool == false)
4454
4455 Value at(std::string_view path) const noexcept {
4456 if (path.empty())
4457 return *this;
4458 if (path[0] != '/')
4459 return {}; // RFC 6901: must start with '/' or be empty
4460 Value cur = *this;
4461 size_t pos = 1;
4462 while (pos <= path.size() && cur) {
4463 const size_t slash = path.find('/', pos);
4464 const std::string_view token = (slash == std::string_view::npos)
4465 ? path.substr(pos)
4466 : path.substr(pos, slash - pos);
4467
4468 // Decode RFC 6901 escapes (~0 → '~', ~1 → '/') only when '~' present
4469 if (token.find('~') != std::string_view::npos) {
4470 std::string decoded;
4471 decoded.reserve(token.size());
4472 for (size_t i = 0; i < token.size(); ++i) {
4473 if (token[i] == '~' && i + 1 < token.size()) {
4474 if (token[i + 1] == '1') {
4475 decoded += '/';
4476 ++i;
4477 } else if (token[i + 1] == '0') {
4478 decoded += '~';
4479 ++i;
4480 } else
4481 decoded += token[i];
4482 } else {
4483 decoded += token[i];
4484 }
4485 }
4486 cur = at_step_(cur, std::string_view(decoded));
4487 } else {
4488 cur = at_step_(cur, token);
4489 }
4490 pos = (slash == std::string_view::npos) ? path.size() + 1 : slash + 1;
4491 }
4492 return cur;
4493 }
4494
4495 // ── at<Path>() — Compile-time JSON Pointer ────────────────────────────────
4496 //
4497 // Validates the path at compile time (must start with '/' or be empty).
4498 // At runtime, delegates to at(path) for navigation.
4499 //
4500 // Usage:
4501 // root.at<"/users/0/name">() // compile-time validated path
4502 // root.at<"">() // returns root itself
4503 // root.at<"no-slash">() // compile error: "must start with '/'"
4504
4505 template <size_t N> struct JsonPointerLiteral {
4506 char data[N]{};
4507 static constexpr size_t size = N > 0 ? N - 1 : 0; // exclude null terminator
4508 consteval JsonPointerLiteral(const char (&s)[N]) {
4509 for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i)
4510 data[i] = s[i];
4511 // Validate: must start with '/' (RFC 6901) or be the empty document root
4512 if constexpr (N > 1) {
4513 if (s[0] != '/')
4514 throw "qbuem::Value::at<Path>: JSON Pointer must start with '/'";
4515 }
4516 }
4517 std::string_view view() const noexcept { return {data, size}; }
4518 };
4519
4520 template <JsonPointerLiteral Path> Value at() const noexcept {
4521 return at(Path.view());
4522 }
4523
4524 // ── merge(other) — shallow object merge ───────────────────────────────────
4525 //
4526 // Copies all key-value pairs from `other` (object) into this object.
4527 // Existing keys with the same name are replaced; new keys are appended.
4528 // `other` must be an object; non-object arguments are silently ignored.
4529 //
4530 // Usage:
4531 // root["config"].merge(defaults); // overlay defaults
4532 // target.merge(source); // shallow merge
4533
4534 void merge(const Value &other) {
4535 if (!is_object() || !other.is_object())
4536 return;
4537 for (auto [k, v] : other.items()) {
4538 erase(k); // mark existing tape key as deleted
4539 erase_from_additions_(k); // remove any previously inserted duplicate
4540 insert(k, v); // append new key-value
4541 }
4542 }
4543
4544 void merge_patch(std::string_view patch_json);
4545
4546 // ── patch(json) — JSON Patch (RFC 6902) ────────────────────────────────────
4547 //
4548 // Applies a JSON Patch array of operations to this value.
4549 // Supported operations: add, remove, replace, move, copy, test.
4550 // Returns true on success, false if any operation fails (atomic-ish).
4551 //
4552 // Usage:
4553 // root.patch(R"([{"op":"add", "path":"/a/b", "value":1}])");
4554 bool patch(std::string_view patch_json);
4555 bool patch(const Value &patch_array);
4556
4557 // ── insert(idx, val) — array-at-index insertion ────────────────────────────
4558 void insert(size_t idx, std::string_view str_val) {
4559 insert_json(idx, scalar_to_json_(str_val));
4560 }
4561 void insert(size_t idx, const Value &v) { insert_json(idx, v.dump()); }
4562 void insert_json(size_t idx, std::string_view raw_json) {
4563 if (!is_array())
4564 return;
4565 doc_->array_insertions_[idx_].push_back({idx, std::string(raw_json)});
4566 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
4567 }
4568
4569private:
4570 // ── Private helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4571
4572 // at_step_: advance one JSON Pointer token from cur.
4573 // Array: token must be a non-negative decimal integer index.
4574 // Object: token is the key string.
4575 static Value at_step_(const Value &cur, std::string_view token) noexcept {
4576 if (cur.is_array()) {
4577 if (token == "-")
4578 return {}; // RFC 6901: end of array (invalid but representable)
4579 if (token.empty())
4580 return {};
4581 // Handle "0" as single digit, or non-zero starting digits
4582 if (token.size() > 1 && token[0] == '0')
4583 return {}; // RFC 6901: leading zeros are not allowed
4584 size_t idx = 0;
4585 auto [ptr, ec] =
4586 std::from_chars(token.data(), token.data() + token.size(), idx);
4587 if (ec != std::errc{} || ptr != token.data() + token.size())
4588 return {};
4589 return cur[idx];
4590 }
4591 return cur[token];
4592 }
4593
4594 // erase_from_additions_: remove all addition entries with the given key.
4595 // Called by merge() / merge_patch() before re-inserting a key.
4596 void erase_from_additions_(std::string_view key) {
4597 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
4598 if (ait == doc_->additions_.end())
4599 return;
4600 auto &vec = ait->second;
4601 std::erase_if(vec, [&](const std::pair<std::string, std::string> &p) {
4602 return std::string_view(p.first) == key;
4603 });
4604 if (vec.empty())
4605 doc_->additions_.erase(ait);
4606 doc_->last_dump_size_ = 0;
4607 }
4608
4609 // merge_patch_impl_: recursive RFC 7396 patch application.
4610 void merge_patch_impl_(const Value &patch) {
4611 if (!is_object() || !patch.is_object())
4612 return;
4613 for (auto [k, v] : patch.items()) {
4614 if (v.is_null()) {
4615 erase(k);
4616 erase_from_additions_(k);
4617 } else {
4618 Value existing = (*this)[k];
4619 if (v.is_object() && existing.is_object()) {
4620 existing.merge_patch_impl_(v); // recursive
4621 } else {
4622 erase(k);
4623 erase_from_additions_(k);
4624 insert(k,
4625 v); // Insert serialized value to ensure cross-document safety
4626 }
4627 }
4628 }
4629 }
4630
4631 // Serialize a scalar to its JSON representation.
4632 static std::string scalar_to_json_(std::nullptr_t) { return "null"; }
4633 static std::string scalar_to_json_(bool b) { return b ? "true" : "false"; }
4634 template <JsonInteger T> static std::string scalar_to_json_(T v) {
4635 char buf[24];
4636 // Dispatch on signedness so unsigned values above INT64_MAX serialize
4637 // correctly (static_cast<int64_t>(UINT64_MAX) would emit "-1").
4638 char *p = std::is_unsigned_v<T>
4639 ? detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<uint64_t>(v))
4640 : detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<int64_t>(v));
4641 return std::string(buf, p);
4642 }
4643 template <JsonFloat T> static std::string scalar_to_json_(T v) {
4644 char buf[40];
4645 char *p = detail::qj_nc::to_chars(buf, static_cast<double>(v));
4646 return std::string(buf, p);
4647 }
4648 // Write s as an escaped JSON string body (no surrounding quotes) into w,
4649 // returning the new write pointer. Used by the mutation/insert paths so
4650 // user-supplied bytes containing '"', '\\', or control characters produce
4651 // valid JSON. Worst-case expansion is 6x (control char -> \u00XX), which
4652 // callers must account for when sizing buffers.
4653 static char *write_escaped_(char *w, std::string_view s) {
4654 static constexpr char kHex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
4655 for (unsigned char c : s) {
4656 switch (c) {
4657 case '"': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = '"'; break;
4658 case '\\': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = '\\'; break;
4659 case '\b': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'b'; break;
4660 case '\f': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'f'; break;
4661 case '\n': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'n'; break;
4662 case '\r': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'r'; break;
4663 case '\t': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 't'; break;
4664 default:
4665 if (c < 0x20) {
4666 *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'u'; *w++ = '0'; *w++ = '0';
4667 *w++ = kHex[c >> 4]; *w++ = kHex[c & 0xF];
4668 } else {
4669 *w++ = static_cast<char>(c);
4670 }
4671 }
4672 }
4673 return w;
4674 }
4675 static std::string scalar_to_json_(std::string_view s) {
4676 std::string r(s.size() * 6 + 2, '\0');
4677 char *w = r.data();
4678 *w++ = '"';
4679 w = write_escaped_(w, s);
4680 *w++ = '"';
4681 r.resize(static_cast<size_t>(w - r.data()));
4682 return r;
4683 }
4684 static std::string scalar_to_json_(const std::string &s) {
4685 return scalar_to_json_(std::string_view(s));
4686 }
4687 static std::string scalar_to_json_(const char *s) {
4688 return scalar_to_json_(std::string_view(s));
4689 }
4690
4691 // Subtree dump for non-root Values (idx_ != 0).
4692 // Iterates tape[idx_..skip_value_(idx_)) and suppresses the first node's
4693 // separator (which encodes position in the parent, not within this subtree).
4694 // Kept out of the main dump() loop so the root hot-path has zero extra
4695 // branches.
4696 std::string dump_subtree_() const {
4697 const char *src = doc_->source.data();
4698 const uint32_t end_i = skip_value_(idx_);
4699
4700 size_t mutation_extra = 0;
4701 for (const auto &[k, m] : doc_->mutations_)
4702 mutation_extra += m.data.size() * 6 + 16; // *6: worst-case escape growth
4703 // Upper bound: subtree content ≤ full source, plus up to 2 chars per tape
4704 // node for separators/quotes the compact serializer inserts. The relaxed
4705 // parser accepts separator-less tokens (e.g. "[1 2 3]" or "2e-3-4"), so the
4706 // dumped form can be LONGER than the source slice — the (end_i - idx_) * 2
4707 // term covers those added separators (mirrors the root dump() bound and
4708 // fixes a heap-buffer-overflow on such inputs).
4709 std::string out;
4710 out.resize(doc_->source.size() +
4711 static_cast<size_t>(end_i - idx_) * 2 + 64 + mutation_extra);
4712 char *w = out.data();
4713 char *w0 = w;
4714
4715 for (uint32_t i = idx_; i < end_i; ++i) {
4716 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[i];
4717 const uint32_t meta = nd.meta;
4718 const auto type = static_cast<TapeNodeType>((meta >> 24) & 0xFF);
4719 // sep for the first node (idx_) is suppressed — it belongs to parent
4720 // context
4721 const uint8_t sep =
4722 (i == idx_) ? 0u : static_cast<uint8_t>((meta >> 16) & 0xFFu);
4723 if (sep)
4724 *w++ = (sep == 0x02u) ? ':' : ',';
4725
4726 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
4727 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(i);
4728 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
4729 const MutationEntry &m = mit->second;
4730 switch (m.type) {
4731 case TapeNodeType::Null:
4732 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
4733 w += 4;
4734 break;
4735 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
4736 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
4737 w += 4;
4738 break;
4739 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
4740 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
4741 w += 5;
4742 break;
4743 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw:
4744 *w++ = '"';
4745 w = write_escaped_(w, m.data); // escape user-set string content
4746 *w++ = '"';
4747 break;
4748 default:
4749 std::memcpy(w, m.data.data(), m.data.size());
4750 w += m.data.size();
4751 break;
4752 }
4753 continue;
4754 }
4755 }
4756
4757 switch (type) {
4758 case TapeNodeType::ObjectStart:
4759 *w++ = '{';
4760 break;
4761 case TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd:
4762 *w++ = '}';
4763 break;
4764 case TapeNodeType::ArrayStart:
4765 *w++ = '[';
4766 break;
4767 case TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd:
4768 *w++ = ']';
4769 break;
4770 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw: {
4771 const uint16_t slen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
4772 const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
4773 const size_t safe_slen =
4774 (nd.offset < src_sz) ? std::min<size_t>(slen, src_sz - nd.offset)
4775 : 0;
4776 *w++ = '"';
4777 std::memcpy(w, src + nd.offset, safe_slen);
4778 w += safe_slen;
4779 *w++ = '"';
4780 break;
4781 }
4782 case TapeNodeType::Integer:
4783 case TapeNodeType::NumberRaw:
4784 case TapeNodeType::Double: {
4785 const uint16_t nlen = static_cast<uint16_t>(meta & 0xFFFFu);
4786 const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
4787 const size_t safe_nlen =
4788 (nd.offset < src_sz) ? std::min<size_t>(nlen, src_sz - nd.offset)
4789 : 0;
4790 std::memcpy(w, src + nd.offset, safe_nlen);
4791 w += safe_nlen;
4792 break;
4793 }
4794 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
4795 std::memcpy(w, "true", 4);
4796 w += 4;
4797 break;
4798 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
4799 std::memcpy(w, "false", 5);
4800 w += 5;
4801 break;
4802 case TapeNodeType::Null:
4803 std::memcpy(w, "null", 4);
4804 w += 4;
4805 break;
4806 default:
4807 break;
4808 }
4809 }
4810 out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(w - w0));
4811 return out;
4812 }
4813
4814 // Write a single mutation entry into a std::string
4815 static void write_mutation_(std::string &out, const MutationEntry &m) {
4816 switch (m.type) {
4817 case TapeNodeType::Null:
4818 out += "null";
4819 break;
4820 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
4821 out += "true";
4822 break;
4823 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
4824 out += "false";
4825 break;
4826 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw:
4827 out += scalar_to_json_(m.data); // quoted + escaped
4828 break;
4829 default: // Integer, Double
4830 out.append(m.data);
4831 break;
4832 }
4833 }
4834
4835 // Full structural dump — used when deleted_ or additions_ are non-empty.
4836 // Uses a stack-based separator approach (not pre-computed sep bits, which
4837 // are invalidated by structural changes).
4838 std::string dump_changes_() const {
4839 const char *src = doc_->source.data();
4840 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
4841
4842 // Compute subtree range
4843 const uint32_t start_c = idx_;
4844 const uint32_t end_c =
4845 (idx_ == 0) ? static_cast<uint32_t>(ntape) : skip_value_(idx_);
4846
4847 std::string out;
4848 out.reserve(doc_->source.size() + doc_->additions_.size() * 64 + 64);
4849
4850 // Per-depth separator state. Sized to the tape Parser's maximum nesting
4851 // depth (1088): the tape can never be deeper, since parse() rejects past
4852 // that. Previously a fixed `Frame stk[64]`, which a document nested deeper
4853 // than 64 overran (stack-buffer-overflow) once a mutation routed dump()
4854 // here. Heap-backed so the deep case adds no stack pressure.
4855 struct Frame {
4856 bool is_obj;
4857 bool has_prev;
4858 bool next_val;
4859 uint32_t start_idx;
4860 size_t arr_idx;
4861 };
4862 std::vector<Frame> stk(1088);
4863 int top = -1;
4864
4865 uint32_t i = start_c;
4866 const TapeNodeType initial_type = doc_->tape[start_c].type();
4867
4868 // Handle initial node if it's an object or array
4869 if (initial_type == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart) {
4870 out += '{';
4871 top++;
4872 stk[top] = {true, false, false, start_c, 0};
4873 i++; // Move past the ObjectStart node
4874 } else if (initial_type == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart) {
4875 out += '[';
4876 top++;
4877 stk[top] = {false, false, false, start_c, 0};
4878 i++; // Move past the ArrayStart node
4879 } else {
4880 // If it's a scalar, just dump it directly without stack logic
4881 // This path is only taken if idx_ is a scalar and there are
4882 // mutations/additions on it, which is handled by the mutation overlay. If
4883 // it's a scalar and no mutations, dump() or dump_subtree_() would have
4884 // been called. So this case should only happen if a scalar has a
4885 // mutation.
4886 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(i);
4887 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
4888 write_mutation_(out, mit->second);
4889 } else {
4890 // Fallback for non-mutated scalar (should not be reached if logic is
4891 // correct) This means a scalar is being dumped via dump_changes_
4892 // without mutations. This is an edge case, but for completeness, we'll
4893 // dump the original value.
4894 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[i];
4895 const uint16_t len = static_cast<uint16_t>(nd.meta & 0xFFFFu);
4896 const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
4897 const size_t safe_len = (nd.offset < src_sz)
4898 ? std::min<size_t>(len, src_sz - nd.offset)
4899 : 0;
4900 if (initial_type == TapeNodeType::StringRaw) {
4901 out += '"';
4902 out.append(src + nd.offset, safe_len);
4903 out += '"';
4904 } else {
4905 out.append(src + nd.offset, safe_len);
4906 }
4907 }
4908 return out; // Scalar value, done.
4909 }
4910
4911 // Separator helper: update frame after writing one complete element
4912 auto done_elem = [](Frame &f) {
4913 if (f.is_obj) {
4914 f.next_val = !f.next_val;
4915 if (!f.next_val)
4916 f.has_prev = true;
4917 } else {
4918 f.has_prev = true;
4919 f.arr_idx++;
4920 }
4921 };
4922 // Write separator before a non-closing node
4923 auto write_sep = [&](Frame &f) {
4924 if (f.is_obj) {
4925 if (f.next_val)
4926 out += ':';
4927 else if (f.has_prev)
4928 out += ',';
4929 } else {
4930 if (f.has_prev)
4931 out += ',';
4932 }
4933 };
4934 // Inject additions before a closing brace/bracket
4935 // Inject additions BEFORE a closing brace/bracket or AT an array index
4936 auto inject_array_adds = [&](uint32_t parent_idx, size_t current_idx) {
4937 if (doc_->array_insertions_.empty())
4938 return;
4939 auto ait = doc_->array_insertions_.find(parent_idx);
4940 if (ait == doc_->array_insertions_.end())
4941 return;
4942 for (const auto &ins : ait->second) {
4943 if (ins.index == current_idx) {
4944 if (stk[top].has_prev)
4945 out += ',';
4946 out += ins.data;
4947 stk[top].has_prev = true;
4948 }
4949 }
4950 };
4951 auto inject_adds = [&](uint32_t parent_idx, Frame &f) {
4952 if (!doc_->additions_.empty()) {
4953 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(parent_idx);
4954 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end()) {
4955 for (const auto &[k, v] : ait->second) {
4956 if (f.has_prev)
4957 out += ',';
4958 if (f.is_obj) {
4959 out += '"';
4960 out += k;
4961 out += "\":";
4962 }
4963 out += v;
4964 f.has_prev = true;
4965 }
4966 }
4967 }
4968 };
4969
4970 while (i < end_c) {
4971 const TapeNode &nd = doc_->tape[i];
4972 const TapeNodeType type =
4973 static_cast<TapeNodeType>((nd.meta >> 24) & 0xFF);
4974
4975 // At key position: check if deleted (object member)
4976 if (top >= 0 && stk[top].is_obj && !stk[top].next_val &&
4977 type != TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd) {
4978 if (!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i)) {
4979 i = skip_value_(i + 1); // skip deleted key + value
4980 continue;
4981 }
4982 }
4983 // At array element: check if deleted or needs insertion
4984 if (top >= 0 && !stk[top].is_obj && type != TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd) {
4985 inject_array_adds(stk[top].start_idx, stk[top].arr_idx);
4986 if (!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i)) {
4987 i = skip_value_(i); // skip deleted element
4988 stk[top].arr_idx++;
4989 continue;
4990 }
4991 }
4992
4993 // Write separator (for non-closing nodes, non-root)
4994 const bool is_close =
4995 (type == TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd || type == TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd);
4996 if (top >= 0 && !is_close && !(i == start_c))
4997 write_sep(stk[top]);
4998
4999 // Mutation overlay
5000 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(!doc_->mutations_.empty())) {
5001 auto mit = doc_->mutations_.find(i);
5002 if (mit != doc_->mutations_.end()) {
5003 write_mutation_(out, mit->second);
5004 if (top >= 0)
5005 done_elem(stk[top]);
5006 ++i;
5007 continue;
5008 }
5009 }
5010
5011 switch (type) {
5012 case TapeNodeType::ObjectStart:
5013 out += '{';
5014 ++top;
5015 stk[top] = {true, false, false, i, 0};
5016 break;
5017 case TapeNodeType::ArrayStart:
5018 out += '[';
5019 ++top;
5020 stk[top] = {false, false, false, i, 0};
5021 break;
5022 case TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd:
5023 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(top < 0)) {
5024 out += '}';
5025 break;
5026 }
5027 inject_adds(stk[top].start_idx, stk[top]);
5028 out += '}';
5029 --top;
5030 if (top >= 0)
5031 done_elem(stk[top]);
5032 break;
5033 case TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd:
5034 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(top < 0)) {
5035 out += ']';
5036 break;
5037 }
5038 inject_adds(stk[top].start_idx, stk[top]);
5039 out += ']';
5040 --top;
5041 if (top >= 0)
5042 done_elem(stk[top]);
5043 break;
5044 case TapeNodeType::StringRaw: {
5045 const uint16_t slen = static_cast<uint16_t>(nd.meta & 0xFFFFu);
5046 const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
5047 const size_t safe_slen =
5048 (nd.offset < src_sz) ? std::min<size_t>(slen, src_sz - nd.offset)
5049 : 0;
5050 out += '"';
5051 out.append(src + nd.offset, safe_slen);
5052 out += '"';
5053 if (top >= 0)
5054 done_elem(stk[top]);
5055 break;
5056 }
5057 case TapeNodeType::Integer:
5058 case TapeNodeType::NumberRaw:
5059 case TapeNodeType::Double: {
5060 const uint16_t nlen = static_cast<uint16_t>(nd.meta & 0xFFFFu);
5061 const size_t src_sz = doc_->source.size();
5062 const size_t safe_nlen =
5063 (nd.offset < src_sz) ? std::min<size_t>(nlen, src_sz - nd.offset)
5064 : 0;
5065 out.append(src + nd.offset, safe_nlen);
5066 if (top >= 0)
5067 done_elem(stk[top]);
5068 break;
5069 }
5070 case TapeNodeType::BooleanTrue:
5071 out += "true";
5072 if (top >= 0)
5073 done_elem(stk[top]);
5074 break;
5075 case TapeNodeType::BooleanFalse:
5076 out += "false";
5077 if (top >= 0)
5078 done_elem(stk[top]);
5079 break;
5080 case TapeNodeType::Null:
5081 out += "null";
5082 if (top >= 0)
5083 done_elem(stk[top]);
5084 break;
5085 default:
5086 break;
5087 }
5088 ++i;
5089 }
5090 return out;
5091 }
5092
5093 // Pretty-print recursive helper
5094 // Returns the tape index just past the value dumped, so callers advance by
5095 // the recursion's actual consumption rather than a second skip_value_ walk.
5096 // This single linear pass visits each tape node at most once, preventing the
5097 // super-linear / exponential output blow-up that skip_value_-per-element
5098 // advancement caused on relaxed (separator-/bracket-mismatched) tapes — a
5099 // 449-byte input previously expanded to a 413 MB pretty dump.
5100 uint32_t dump_pretty_(std::string &out, int indent_size, int depth) const {
5101 if (!doc_) {
5102 out += "null";
5103 return idx_ + 1;
5104 }
5105 // Bound recursion: each level adds a C++ stack frame, and the parser permits
5106 // nesting up to ~1088, which can exhaust a small (worker/embedded) thread
5107 // stack. Beyond a generous cap, fall back to the iterative compact dump of
5108 // this subtree (still valid JSON, just not indented past this point).
5109 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(depth > 500)) {
5110 out += dump();
5111 return skip_value_(idx_);
5112 }
5113 const TapeNodeType root_type = doc_->tape[idx_].type();
5114
5115 if (root_type == TapeNodeType::ObjectStart) {
5116 out += '{';
5117 bool first = true;
5118 std::string pad(static_cast<size_t>((depth + 1) * indent_size), ' ');
5119 std::string close_pad(static_cast<size_t>(depth * indent_size), ' ');
5120 // tape entries
5121 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
5122 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
5123 while (i < ntape && doc_->tape[i].type() != TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd) {
5124 if (!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i)) {
5125 i = skip_value_(i + 1);
5126 continue;
5127 }
5128 if (!first)
5129 out += ',';
5130 out += '\n';
5131 out += pad;
5132 // key
5133 const TapeNode &kn = doc_->tape[i];
5134 out += '"';
5135 out.append(doc_->source.data() + kn.offset, kn.length());
5136 out += '"';
5137 out += ": ";
5138 // Advance by the recursion's own end index (linear, no re-walk).
5139 i = Value(doc_, i + 1).dump_pretty_(out, indent_size, depth + 1);
5140 first = false;
5141 }
5142 // additions
5143 if (!doc_->additions_.empty()) {
5144 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
5145 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end()) {
5146 for (const auto &[k, v] : ait->second) {
5147 if (!first)
5148 out += ',';
5149 out += '\n';
5150 out += pad;
5151 out += '"';
5152 out += k;
5153 out += "\": ";
5154 out += v;
5155 first = false;
5156 }
5157 }
5158 }
5159 if (!first) {
5160 out += '\n';
5161 out += close_pad;
5162 }
5163 out += '}';
5164 return (i < ntape) ? i + 1 : i; // index past the ObjectEnd node
5165 } else if (root_type == TapeNodeType::ArrayStart) {
5166 out += '[';
5167 bool first = true;
5168 std::string pad(static_cast<size_t>((depth + 1) * indent_size), ' ');
5169 std::string close_pad(static_cast<size_t>(depth * indent_size), ' ');
5170 uint32_t i = idx_ + 1;
5171 const size_t ntape = doc_->tape.size();
5172 while (i < ntape && doc_->tape[i].type() != TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd) {
5173 if (!doc_->deleted_.empty() && doc_->deleted_.count(i)) {
5174 i = skip_value_(i);
5175 continue;
5176 }
5177 if (!first)
5178 out += ',';
5179 out += '\n';
5180 out += pad;
5181 // Advance by the recursion's own end index (linear, no re-walk).
5182 i = Value(doc_, i).dump_pretty_(out, indent_size, depth + 1);
5183 first = false;
5184 }
5185 // additions
5186 if (!doc_->additions_.empty()) {
5187 auto ait = doc_->additions_.find(idx_);
5188 if (ait != doc_->additions_.end()) {
5189 for (const auto &[k, v] : ait->second) {
5190 if (!first)
5191 out += ',';
5192 out += '\n';
5193 out += pad;
5194 out += v;
5195 first = false;
5196 }
5197 }
5198 }
5199 if (!first) {
5200 out += '\n';
5201 out += close_pad;
5202 }
5203 out += ']';
5204 return (i < ntape) ? i + 1 : i; // index past the ArrayEnd node
5205 } else {
5206 // scalar — just use fast dump()
5207 out += dump();
5208 return idx_ + 1;
5209 }
5210 }
5211};
5212
5213// NEON Structural Scanner utilities
5214//
5215// Verified correct via phase19_test.cpp before integration.
5216
5217// Load 8 bytes without UB
5218static QBUEM_INLINE uint64_t load64(const char *p) noexcept {
5219 uint64_t v;
5220 std::memcpy(&v, p, 8);
5221 return v;
5222}
5223
5224// SWAR action mask: bit 7 of each byte set iff byte is non-WS (>= 0x21)
5225static QBUEM_INLINE uint64_t swar_action_mask(uint64_t v) noexcept {
5226 constexpr uint64_t K = 0x0101010101010101ULL;
5227 constexpr uint64_t H = 0x8080808080808080ULL;
5228 constexpr uint64_t BROAD = K * 0x21;
5229 uint64_t sub = v - BROAD;
5230 uint64_t skip = sub & H;
5231 return ~skip & H;
5232}
5233
5234#if QBUEM_HAS_NEON
5235
5236// NEON movemask: 16-bit bitmask from 16-byte 0xFF/0x00 vector.
5237// Bit i set iff byte i was 0xFF.
5238// Uses vshrq_n_u8 + vmulq_u8 + vpaddlq reduction — zero memory loads.
5239// kW is a compile-time constant; Clang encodes it as a NEON immediate.
5240static QBUEM_INLINE uint16_t neon_movemask(uint8x16_t mask) noexcept {
5241 // Step 1: convert 0xFF→1, 0x00→0 per byte
5242 uint8x16_t bits = vshrq_n_u8(mask, 7);
5243 // Step 2: weight each byte by its bit position 2^(i%8)
5244 // kW is a constexpr literal; no memory load generated by Clang -O2.
5245 static const uint8_t kW[16] = {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128,
5246 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128};
5247 const uint8x16_t wv =
5248 vld1q_u8(kW); // hoisted to register by compiler since kW is static
5249 uint8x16_t weighted = vmulq_u8(bits, wv);
5250 // Step 3: horizontal reduce: 16 bytes → 8 uint16 → 4 uint32 → 2 uint64
5251 // s64[0] = sum of weighted bytes 0-7 (= low byte of result, bits 0-7)
5252 // s64[1] = sum of weighted bytes 8-15 (= high byte, bits 8-15)
5253 uint16x8_t s16 = vpaddlq_u8(weighted);
5254 uint32x4_t s32 = vpaddlq_u16(s16);
5255 uint64x2_t s64 = vpaddlq_u32(s32);
5256 return (uint16_t)(vgetq_lane_u64(s64, 0) | (vgetq_lane_u64(s64, 1) << 8));
5257}
5258
5259#endif // QBUEM_HAS_NEON
5260
5261// Stage 1 AVX-512 Structural Scanner
5262//
5263// Scans json[0..len) and writes byte offsets to:
5264// '{' '}' '[' ']' ':' ',' — outside strings
5265// '"' (opening AND closing quote of every string)
5266// value starts (digit, '-', 't', 'f', 'n') — outside strings
5267//
5268// Stage 2 (parse_staged) uses this index to:
5269// • Skip whitespace scanning entirely (no skip_to_action calls)
5270// • Compute string length as O(1): close_offset - open_offset - 1
5271//
5272// Uses same escape / in-string algorithm as fill_bitmap() for correctness.
5273#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
5274QBUEM_INLINE void stage1_scan_avx512(const char *src, size_t len,
5275 Stage1Index &idx) {
5276 // Upper bound: at most every byte is structural (e.g. "[[[[[")
5277 idx.reserve(len + 1);
5278 idx.reset();
5279 uint32_t *out = idx.positions;
5280 uint32_t count = 0;
5281
5282 const char *p = src;
5283 const char *end = src + len;
5284
5285 uint64_t prev_in_string = 0; // all-0 = outside string; all-1 = inside string
5286 bool prev_escaped = false;
5287 uint64_t prev_non_ws = (1ULL << 63); // treat start as after whitespace
5288
5289 // Pre-load broadcast constants outside the loop (hoisted to registers).
5290 const __m512i v_brace_o = _mm512_set1_epi8('{');
5291 const __m512i v_brace_c = _mm512_set1_epi8('}');
5292 const __m512i v_bracket_o = _mm512_set1_epi8('[');
5293 const __m512i v_bracket_c = _mm512_set1_epi8(']');
5294 const __m512i v_colon = _mm512_set1_epi8(':');
5295 const __m512i v_comma = _mm512_set1_epi8(',');
5296 const __m512i v_quote = _mm512_set1_epi8('"');
5297 const __m512i v_backslash = _mm512_set1_epi8('\\');
5298 const __m512i v_ws_thresh = _mm512_set1_epi8(0x20);
5299
5300 while (p + 64 <= end) {
5301 __m512i v = _mm512_loadu_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(p));
5302
5303 uint64_t q_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_quote);
5304 uint64_t bs_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_backslash);
5305 // split structural chars into bracket_bits ({}[]) and sep_bits
5306 // (:,). sep_bits participates in ws_like/vstart computation (so values
5307 // after :, are still detected as vstart), but is NOT included in the
5308 // emitted structural bitmask — shrinks positions[] by ~33% for string-heavy
5309 // files (twitter, citm).
5310 uint64_t bracket_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_brace_o) |
5311 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_brace_c) |
5312 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_bracket_o) |
5313 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_bracket_c);
5314 uint64_t sep_bits =
5315 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_colon) | _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_comma);
5316 uint64_t s_bits = bracket_bits | sep_bits; // used only for ws_like / vstart
5317 // Signed cmpgt: 0x21-0x7F → 1 (non-ws ASCII). 0x80-0xFF treated as ws,
5318 // but UTF-8 continuation bytes only appear inside strings (masked by
5319 // ~inside).
5320 uint64_t non_ws =
5321 static_cast<uint64_t>(_mm512_cmpgt_epi8_mask(v, v_ws_thresh));
5322
5323 // ── Escape propagation (identical to fill_bitmap()) ───────────────────
5324 uint64_t escaped = 0;
5325 uint64_t temp_esc = bs_bits;
5326 if (prev_escaped) {
5327 escaped |= 1ULL;
5328 prev_escaped = false;
5329 if (temp_esc & 1ULL)
5330 temp_esc &= ~1ULL;
5331 }
5332 while (temp_esc) {
5333 int start = __builtin_ctzll(temp_esc);
5334 uint64_t mask_from_start = ~0ULL << start;
5335 uint64_t non_bs_from_start = ~bs_bits & mask_from_start;
5336 int run_end =
5337 (non_bs_from_start == 0) ? 64 : __builtin_ctzll(non_bs_from_start);
5338 int run_len = run_end - start;
5339 for (int j = start + 1; j < run_end; j += 2)
5340 escaped |= (1ULL << j);
5341 if (run_len % 2 != 0) {
5342 if (run_end < 64)
5343 escaped |= (1ULL << run_end);
5344 else
5345 prev_escaped = true;
5346 }
5347 if (run_end == 64)
5348 break;
5349 temp_esc &= (~0ULL << run_end);
5350 }
5351
5352 uint64_t clean_quotes = q_bits & ~escaped;
5353 uint64_t in_string = simd::prefix_xor(clean_quotes) ^ prev_in_string;
5354 uint64_t inside = in_string & ~clean_quotes;
5355
5356 uint64_t external_non_ws = non_ws & ~inside;
5357 // Structural chars outside strings + all real quotes (open & close)
5358 uint64_t external_symbols = (s_bits & ~inside) | clean_quotes;
5359 uint64_t ws_like = (~non_ws & ~inside) | external_symbols;
5360 // vstart: first byte of each number/bool/null (non-ws, non-structural,
5361 // outside strings, following whitespace or a structural character)
5362 uint64_t vstart = (external_non_ws & ~external_symbols) &
5363 (ws_like << 1 | (prev_non_ws >> 63));
5364
5365 // emit bracket_bits ({[}]) + quotes + vstart — omit sep_bits
5366 // (:,). sep_bits is still in external_symbols (for correct ws_like/vstart),
5367 // but Stage 2 (parse_staged) infers context from the push() bit-stack
5368 // without needing explicit :, position entries.
5369 uint64_t structural = ((bracket_bits & ~inside) | clean_quotes) | vstart;
5370
5371 // Write positions to flat array
5372 uint32_t base = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - src);
5373 while (structural) {
5374 int bit = __builtin_ctzll(structural);
5375 out[count++] = base + static_cast<uint32_t>(bit);
5376 structural &= structural - 1;
5377 }
5378
5379 prev_in_string =
5380 static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(in_string) >> 63);
5381 prev_non_ws = ws_like;
5382 p += 64;
5383 }
5384
5385 // ── Tail: pad remaining bytes to 64 with spaces ───────────────────────
5386 size_t remaining = static_cast<size_t>(end - p);
5387 if (remaining > 0) {
5388 alignas(64) char buf[64];
5389 std::memset(buf, ' ', 64);
5390 std::memcpy(buf, p, remaining);
5391
5392 __m512i v = _mm512_load_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(buf));
5393
5394 uint64_t q_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_quote);
5395 uint64_t bs_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_backslash);
5396 uint64_t bracket_bits = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_brace_o) |
5397 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_brace_c) |
5398 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_bracket_o) |
5399 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_bracket_c);
5400 uint64_t sep_bits =
5401 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_colon) | _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, v_comma);
5402 uint64_t s_bits = bracket_bits | sep_bits;
5403 uint64_t non_ws =
5404 static_cast<uint64_t>(_mm512_cmpgt_epi8_mask(v, v_ws_thresh));
5405
5406 // Mask to valid bytes only
5407 uint64_t m = (remaining >= 64) ? ~0ULL : (1ULL << remaining) - 1;
5408 q_bits &= m;
5409 bs_bits &= m;
5410 bracket_bits &= m;
5411 sep_bits &= m;
5412 s_bits &= m;
5413 non_ws &= m;
5414
5415 uint64_t escaped = 0;
5416 uint64_t temp_esc = bs_bits;
5417 if (prev_escaped) {
5418 escaped |= 1ULL;
5419 prev_escaped = false;
5420 if (temp_esc & 1ULL)
5421 temp_esc &= ~1ULL;
5422 }
5423 while (temp_esc) {
5424 int start = __builtin_ctzll(temp_esc);
5425 uint64_t mask_from_start = ~0ULL << start;
5426 uint64_t non_bs_from_start = ~bs_bits & mask_from_start;
5427 int run_end =
5428 (non_bs_from_start == 0) ? 64 : __builtin_ctzll(non_bs_from_start);
5429 int run_len = run_end - start;
5430 for (int j = start + 1; j < run_end; j += 2)
5431 escaped |= (1ULL << j);
5432 if (run_len % 2 != 0 && run_end < 64)
5433 escaped |= (1ULL << run_end);
5434 if (run_end == 64)
5435 break;
5436 temp_esc &= (~0ULL << run_end);
5437 }
5438
5439 uint64_t clean_quotes = (q_bits & ~escaped) & m;
5440 uint64_t in_string = simd::prefix_xor(clean_quotes) ^ prev_in_string;
5441 uint64_t inside = in_string & ~clean_quotes;
5442
5443 uint64_t external_non_ws = non_ws & ~inside;
5444 uint64_t external_symbols = (s_bits & ~inside) | clean_quotes;
5445 uint64_t ws_like = (~non_ws & ~inside) | external_symbols;
5446 uint64_t vstart = (external_non_ws & ~external_symbols) &
5447 (ws_like << 1 | (prev_non_ws >> 63));
5448
5449 // emit only bracket_bits + quotes + vstart (no :,)
5450 uint64_t structural =
5451 (((bracket_bits & ~inside) | clean_quotes) | vstart) & m;
5452
5453 uint32_t base = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - src);
5454 while (structural) {
5455 int bit = __builtin_ctzll(structural);
5456 out[count++] = base + static_cast<uint32_t>(bit);
5457 structural &= structural - 1;
5458 }
5459 }
5460
5461 idx.count = count;
5462}

5651
5652 uint32_t base = static_cast<uint32_t>(p - src);
5653 while (structural) {
5654 int bit = __builtin_ctzll(structural);
5655 out[count++] = base + static_cast<uint32_t>(bit);
5656 structural &= structural - 1;
5657 }
5658 }
5659
5660 idx.count = count;
5661}
5662#endif // QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
5663
5664// 256-Entry constexpr Action LUT
5665//
5666// Replaces the 17-case switch(c) in parse() with an 11-entry
5667// switch(kActionLut[c]). Fewer cases → better Branch Target Buffer
5668// utilisation on both M1 (aarch64) and x86_64 out-of-order cores.
5669// The 256-byte table fits in 4 L1 cache lines and is hoisted to a
5670// register by the compiler after the first access.
5671// Architecture-agnostic pure C++ — no SIMD required.
5672
5673enum ActionId : uint8_t {
5674 kActNone = 0, // whitespace or unknown — should not reach switch
5675 kActString = 1,
5676 kActNumber = 2,
5677 kActObjOpen = 3,
5678 kActArrOpen = 4,
5679 kActClose = 5, // '}' or ']'
5680 kActColon = 6,
5681 kActComma = 7,
5682 kActTrue = 8,
5683 kActFalse = 9,
5684 kActNull = 10,
5685};
5686
5687static constexpr auto kActionLut = []() consteval {
5688 std::array<uint8_t, 256> t{}; // zero-initialised: kActNone (0)
5689 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('"')] = kActString;
5690 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('-')] = kActNumber;
5691 // digits '0'..'9'
5692 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('0')] = kActNumber;
5693 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('1')] = kActNumber;
5694 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('2')] = kActNumber;
5695 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('3')] = kActNumber;
5696 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('4')] = kActNumber;
5697 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('5')] = kActNumber;
5698 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('6')] = kActNumber;
5699 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('7')] = kActNumber;
5700 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('8')] = kActNumber;
5701 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('9')] = kActNumber;
5702 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('{')] = kActObjOpen;
5703 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('[')] = kActArrOpen;
5704 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('}')] = kActClose;
5705 t[static_cast<uint8_t>(']')] = kActClose;
5706 t[static_cast<uint8_t>(':')] = kActColon;
5707 t[static_cast<uint8_t>(',')] = kActComma;
5708 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('t')] = kActTrue;
5709 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('f')] = kActFalse;
5710 t[static_cast<uint8_t>('n')] = kActNull;
5711 return t;
5712}();
5713
5714// Parser — hot loop
5715
5716class Parser {
5717 const char *p_;
5718 const char *end_;
5719 const char *data_;
5720 DocumentState *doc_;
5721 size_t depth_ = 0;
5722
5723 // compact per-depth context state.
5724 // Replaces 3×64-bit bit-stacks + overflow array with one byte per depth.
5725 // bit0 = is_key (next push is an object key)
5726 // bit1 = in_obj (current depth is an object, not array)
5727 // bit2 = has_elem (≥1 element already pushed at this depth)
5728 //
5729 // cur_state_ is register-resident throughout parse() — no memory access per
5730 // push(). cstate_stack_[d] saves/restores the parent depth's state on
5731 // open/close bracket events (infrequent: ~8% of tokens in twitter.json).
5732 // Supports up to depth 1087 (same as old bit-stack + overflow).
5733 uint8_t cur_state_ = 0;
5734 // Maximum structural nesting depth. Inputs nested deeper than this are
5735 // rejected at parse time. Without this cap, each '{'/'[' writes
5736 // cstate_stack_[depth_] with no bound check, so adversarial deeply-nested
5737 // input (e.g. "[[[[…") overruns the stack array — a stack-buffer-overflow
5738 // on untrusted input. 1088 is far beyond any real-world JSON nesting.
5739 static constexpr uint32_t kMaxDepth = 1088;
5740 uint8_t cstate_stack_[kMaxDepth] = {};
5741
5742 // Technique 8: local tape_head_ register variable.
5743 // Kept as a field but initialized from doc_->tape.base in parse().
5744 // The compiler will register-allocate this across the entire parse() body,
5745 // eliminating the pointer-chain access doc_->tape.head on every push().
5746 TapeNode *tape_head_ = nullptr;
5747
5748 // (The schema-prediction KeyLenCache was removed: its O(1) cache-hit check
5749 // was unsound and mis-parsed heterogeneous sibling objects — see the note in
5750 // scan_key_colon_next. The SIMD/SWAR key scanner is always used.)
5751
5752 // ── skip_to_action: SWAR-8 + scalar whitespace skip chain ──
5753 // Returns the first action byte and advances p_ past whitespace.
5754 // Use the returned char directly in switch(c) — avoids extra *p_ read.
5755 //
5756 // NEON path is intentionally disabled here: for twitter.json's whitespace
5757 // distribution (typically 2-8 consecutive WS bytes between tokens), the
5758 // vld1q_u8 overhead exceeds the gain vs SWAR-8. NEON accelerates bulk
5759 // whitespace (>16 consecutive bytes), which is rare here.
5760 QBUEM_INLINE char skip_to_action() noexcept {
5761 // Fast path: already on action byte.
5762 // Guard p_ < end_ before dereferencing: callers may reach here with
5763 // p_ == end_ (e.g. unterminated array/object like "[").
5764 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(p_ >= end_))
5765 return 0;
5766 unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_);
5767 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(c > 0x20))
5768 return static_cast<char>(c);
5769
5770#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
5771 // ── AVX-512 64B batch whitespace skip ──────────────────────────
5772 // _mm512_cmpgt_epi8_mask vs 0x20 is 1 op (vs AVX2's 8 ops for 32B).
5773 // 64B/iter vs SWAR-32's 32B/iter → ~2× throughput for whitespace-heavy
5774 // JSON.
5775 //
5776 // SWAR-8 pre-gate: twitter.json has 2-8 WS bytes between tokens; absorb
5777 // them here before paying any 512-bit register setup cost ( // lesson).
5778 // Guard `p_ + 8 <= end_`: load64() reads 8 bytes, and the input is an
5779 // unpadded caller-supplied string_view, so without this an input ending
5780 // within 7 bytes of a page boundary reads out of bounds. When too close
5781 // to the end, fall through to the scalar tail below.
5782 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 8 <= end_)) {
5783 uint64_t am = swar_action_mask(load64(p_));
5784 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(am != 0)) {
5785 p_ += QBUEM_CTZ(am) >> 3;
5786 return *p_;
5787 }
5788 p_ += 8;
5789 }
5790 // Still in whitespace → bulk path: AVX-512 64B/iter for long WS runs.
5791 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 64 <= end_)) {
5792 const __m512i ws_thresh = _mm512_set1_epi8(0x20);
5793 do {
5794 __m512i v = _mm512_loadu_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(p_));
5795 uint64_t non_ws =
5796 static_cast<uint64_t>(_mm512_cmpgt_epi8_mask(v, ws_thresh));
5797 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(non_ws)) {
5798 p_ += __builtin_ctzll(non_ws);
5799 return *p_;
5800 }
5801 p_ += 64;
5802 } while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 64 <= end_));
5803 }
5804 // <64B tail: SWAR-8 scalar walk
5805 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 8 <= end_)) {
5806 uint64_t am = swar_action_mask(load64(p_));
5807 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(am != 0)) {
5808 p_ += QBUEM_CTZ(am) >> 3;
5809 return *p_;
5810 }
5811 p_ += 8;
5812 }
5813#elif QBUEM_HAS_NEON
5814 // ── Global AArch64 NEON Loop ──────────────────────────────────
5815 // SWAR pre-gates are strictly avoided on AArch64 because vector setup
5816 // (vld1q) and max-reduce (vmaxvq) have significantly lower latency and
5817 // higher throughput than scalar GPR dependencies on both Apple Silicon
5818 // and Generic ARM cores.
5819 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 16 <= end_)) {
5820 uint8x16_t v = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(p_));
5821 uint8x16_t mask = vcgtq_u8(v, vdupq_n_u8(0x20));
5822 // vmaxvq returns the max 32-bit element. If any byte was > 0x20,
5823 // the mask will have 0xFF in that byte, so the max 32-bit element
5824 // will be != 0.
5825 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(mask)) != 0)) {
5826 // Find exact position via auto-vectorized loop
5827 while (static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_) <= 0x20)
5828 ++p_;
5829 return *p_;
5830 }
5831 p_ += 16;
5832 }
5833#else
5834 // SWAR-32 fallback (no SIMD available)
5835 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 32 <= end_)) {
5836 uint64_t a0 = swar_action_mask(load64(p_));
5837 uint64_t a1 = swar_action_mask(load64(p_ + 8));
5838 uint64_t a2 = swar_action_mask(load64(p_ + 16));
5839 uint64_t a3 = swar_action_mask(load64(p_ + 24));
5840 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(a0 | a1 | a2 | a3)) {
5841 if (a0) {
5842 p_ += QBUEM_CTZ(a0) >> 3;
5843 return *p_;
5844 }
5845 if (a1) {
5846 p_ += 8 + (QBUEM_CTZ(a1) >> 3);
5847 return *p_;
5848 }
5849 if (a2) {
5850 p_ += 16 + (QBUEM_CTZ(a2) >> 3);
5851 return *p_;
5852 }
5853 p_ += 24 + (QBUEM_CTZ(a3) >> 3);
5854 return *p_;
5855 }
5856 p_ += 32;
5857 }
5858 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ + 8 <= end_)) {
5859 uint64_t am = swar_action_mask(load64(p_));
5860 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(am != 0)) {
5861 p_ += QBUEM_CTZ(am) >> 3;
5862 return *p_;
5863 }
5864 p_ += 8;
5865 }
5866#endif
5867
5868 // Scalar tail
5869 while (p_ < end_) {
5870 c = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_);
5871 if (c > 0x20)
5872 return static_cast<char>(c);
5873 ++p_;
5874 }
5875 return 0;
5876 }
5877
5878 // ── Contextual SIMD Gate String Scanner ─────────────
5879 //
5880 // Theory: reverted NEON because it added startup overhead on
5881 // short strings. Root fix: an 8B SWAR gate runs first. Short strings
5882 // (≤8 chars, ≈36% of twitter.json) exit immediately at ZERO SIMD cost.
5883 // Only when the string is confirmed > 8 chars do we enter the SIMD loop.
5884 //
5885 // Architecture dispatch order:
5886 // aarch64 (NEON 16B) ← PRIMARY — M1 / ARMv8+
5887 // x86_64 (SSE2 16B) ← SECONDARY — Nehalem+, all modern x86
5888 // generic (SWAR-16) ← FALLBACK
5889 QBUEM_INLINE const char *scan_string_end(const char *p) noexcept {
5890 constexpr uint64_t K = 0x0101010101010101ULL;
5891 constexpr uint64_t H = 0x8080808080808080ULL;
5892 const uint64_t qm = K * static_cast<uint8_t>('"');
5893 const uint64_t bsm = K * static_cast<uint8_t>('\\');
5894
5895 // ── Stage 1: 8B SWAR gate ──────────────────────────────────────
5896 // Short strings (≤8 chars) exit here with zero SIMD overhead.
5897 // Backslash-early strings also exit early (benefit escape-heavy JSON).
5898#if !QBUEM_HAS_NEON
5899 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 8 <= end_)) {
5900 uint64_t v0;
5901 std::memcpy(&v0, p, 8);
5902 uint64_t hq0 = v0 ^ qm;
5903 hq0 = (hq0 - K) & ~hq0 & H;
5904 uint64_t hb0 = v0 ^ bsm;
5905 hb0 = (hb0 - K) & ~hb0 & H;
5906 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(hq0 | hb0))
5907 return p + (QBUEM_CTZ(hq0 | hb0) >> 3);
5908 p += 8; // string confirmed > 8 chars: advance to SIMD
5909 }
5910#endif
5911
5912 // ── Stage 2: SIMD loop (string > 8 chars confirmed) ───────────
5913
5914#if QBUEM_HAS_NEON
5915 // aarch64 PRIMARY: NEON 16B. Pinpoint via scalar fallback loop.
5916 {
5917 const uint8x16_t vq = vdupq_n_u8('"');
5918 const uint8x16_t vbs = vdupq_n_u8('\\');
5919 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 16 <= end_)) {
5920 uint8x16_t v = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(p));
5921 uint8x16_t m = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v, vq), vceqq_u8(v, vbs));
5922 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m)) != 0)) {
5923 // Pinpoint: AArch64 strongly prefers scalar loop over
5924 // cross-register extraction latency.
5925 while (*p != '"' && *p != '\\')
5926 ++p;
5927 return p;
5928 }
5929 p += 16;
5930 }
5931 }
5932#elif QBUEM_HAS_AVX2
5933 // x86_64 AVX2/AVX-512: SIMD string scanner.
5934 // AVX2 32B. : AVX-512 64B outer loop (when available).
5935 // aarch64 agents: inactive on M1 builds. x86_64: build with -march=native.
5936#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
5937 // AVX-512 64B per iteration — halves loop count vs AVX2.
5938 // _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask → uint64_t mask directly (no vpor needed).
5939 {
5940 const __m512i vq512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('"');
5941 const __m512i vbs512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('\\');
5942 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 64 <= end_)) {
5943 __m512i v = _mm512_loadu_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(p));
5944 uint64_t mask = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, vq512) |
5945 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, vbs512);
5946 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(mask)) {
5947 p += __builtin_ctzll(mask);
5948 return p;
5949 }
5950 p += 64;
5951 }
5952 }
5953 // Fall through: AVX2 32B handles remaining <64B
5954#endif
5955 {
5956 const __m256i vq = _mm256_set1_epi8('"');
5957 const __m256i vbs = _mm256_set1_epi8('\\');
5958 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 32 <= end_)) {
5959 __m256i v = _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i *>(p));
5960 uint32_t mask =
5961 static_cast<uint32_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(_mm256_or_si256(
5962 _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq), _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs))));
5963 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(mask))
5964 return p + __builtin_ctz(mask);
5965 p += 32;
5966 }
5967 }
5968 // SSE2 16B tail (handles remaining <32B after AVX2 loop)
5969 {
5970 const __m128i vq = _mm_set1_epi8('"');
5971 const __m128i vbs = _mm_set1_epi8('\\');
5972 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 16 <= end_)) {
5973 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
5974 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(
5975 _mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq), _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs)));
5976 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(mask))
5977 return p + __builtin_ctz(mask);
5978 p += 16;
5979 }
5980 }
5981#elif defined(QBUEM_ARCH_X86_64)
5982 // x86_64 SECONDARY (SSE2 only, no AVX2): 16B per iteration.
5983 {
5984 const __m128i vq = _mm_set1_epi8('"');
5985 const __m128i vbs = _mm_set1_epi8('\\');
5986 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 16 <= end_)) {
5987 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
5988 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(
5989 _mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq), _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs)));
5990 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(mask))
5991 return p + __builtin_ctz(mask);
5992 p += 16;
5993 }
5994 }
5995#else
5996 // Generic SWAR-16 fallback (no SIMD available)
5997 while (p + 16 <= end_) {
5998 uint64_t v0, v1;
5999 std::memcpy(&v0, p, 8);
6000 std::memcpy(&v1, p + 8, 8);
6001 uint64_t hq0 = v0 ^ qm;
6002 hq0 = (hq0 - K) & ~hq0 & H;
6003 uint64_t hb0 = v0 ^ bsm;
6004 hb0 = (hb0 - K) & ~hb0 & H;
6005 uint64_t hq1 = v1 ^ qm;
6006 hq1 = (hq1 - K) & ~hq1 & H;
6007 uint64_t hb1 = v1 ^ bsm;
6008 hb1 = (hb1 - K) & ~hb1 & H;
6009 uint64_t m0 = hq0 | hb0, m1 = hq1 | hb1;
6010 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(m0 | m1)) {
6011 if (m0)
6012 return p + (QBUEM_CTZ(m0) >> 3);
6013 return p + 8 + (QBUEM_CTZ(m1) >> 3);
6014 }
6015 p += 16;
6016 }
6017#endif
6018
6019 // ── Tail: 8B SWAR + scalar ─────────────────────────────────────
6020 if (p + 8 <= end_) {
6021 uint64_t v;
6022 std::memcpy(&v, p, 8);
6023 uint64_t hq = v ^ qm;
6024 hq = (hq - K) & ~hq & H;
6025 uint64_t hb = v ^ bsm;
6026 hb = (hb - K) & ~hb & H;
6027 uint64_t m = hq | hb;
6028 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(m))
6029 return p + (QBUEM_CTZ(m) >> 3);
6030 p += 8;
6031 }
6032 while (p < end_ && *p != '"' && *p != '\\')
6033 ++p;
6034 return p;
6035 }
6036
6037 QBUEM_INLINE const char *skip_string(const char *p) noexcept {
6038 while (p < end_) {
6039 p = scan_string_end(p);
6040 if (p >= end_)
6041 return end_;
6042 if (*p == '"')
6043 return p;
6044 p += 2;
6045 }
6046 return p;
6047 }
6048
6049 // ── skip_string_from32
6050 // ───────────────────────────────────────── Like skip_string(s+32) but
6051 // skips the SWAR-8 gate in scan_string_end. Called when bytes [s, s+32)
6052 // are already confirmed clean by kActString's AVX2 inline scan.
6053 // Saves ~11 scalar instructions per call by using AVX2 directly at p =
6054 // s+32 (no 8-byte prologue). For strings 32-63 chars: 1 AVX2 op total vs
6055 // SWAR-8+AVX2 (17 instructions).
6056 QBUEM_INLINE const char *skip_string_from32(const char *s) noexcept {
6057 const char *p = s + 32;
6058#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX2
6059 const __m256i vq = _mm256_set1_epi8('"');
6060 const __m256i vbs = _mm256_set1_epi8('\\');
6061 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 32 <= end_)) {
6062 __m256i v = _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i *>(p));
6063 uint32_t mask =
6064 static_cast<uint32_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(_mm256_or_si256(
6065 _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq), _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs))));
6066 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(mask != 0)) {
6067 p += __builtin_ctz(mask);
6068 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*p == '"'))
6069 return p;
6070 p += 2; // skip escape sequence (backslash + next byte)
6071 continue;
6072 }
6073 p += 32;
6074 }
6075 // ── Tail: SSE2 16B (handles remaining <32B) ──────────────────────────
6076 {
6077 const __m128i vq128 = _mm_set1_epi8('"');
6078 const __m128i vbs128 = _mm_set1_epi8('\\');
6079 while (p + 16 <= end_) {
6080 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
6081 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(
6082 _mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq128), _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs128)));
6083 if (mask) {
6084 p += __builtin_ctz(mask);
6085 if (*p == '"')
6086 return p;
6087 p += 2;
6088 break;
6089 }
6090 p += 16;
6091 }
6092 }
6093#endif
6094 // SWAR-8 + scalar tail (platform-agnostic, handles last <16B)
6095 while (p < end_) {
6096 p = scan_string_end(p);
6097 if (p >= end_)
6098 return end_;
6099 if (*p == '"')
6100 return p;
6101 p += 2;
6102 }
6103 return p;
6104 }
6105
6106 // ── skip_string_from64
6107 // ───────────────────────────────────────── Like skip_string_from32 but
6108 // starts 64B further (s+64). Called when bytes [s, s+64) are confirmed
6109 // clean by an AVX-512 inline scan. For strings 64-127 chars: 1 AVX-512 op
6110 // total vs full scan_string_end().
6111#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
6112 QBUEM_INLINE const char *skip_string_from64(const char *s) noexcept {
6113 const char *p = s + 64;
6114 {
6115 const __m512i vq512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('"');
6116 const __m512i vbs512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('\\');
6117 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 64 <= end_)) {
6118 __m512i v = _mm512_loadu_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(p));
6119 uint64_t mask = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, vq512) |
6120 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(v, vbs512);
6121 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(mask != 0)) {
6122 p += __builtin_ctzll(mask);
6123 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*p == '"'))
6124 return p;
6125 p += 2; // skip escape sequence
6126 continue;
6127 }
6128 p += 64;
6129 }
6130 }
6131 // AVX2 32B tail (handles remaining <64B)
6132 {
6133 const __m256i vq = _mm256_set1_epi8('"');
6134 const __m256i vbs = _mm256_set1_epi8('\\');
6135 while (QBUEM_LIKELY(p + 32 <= end_)) {
6136 __m256i v = _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i *>(p));
6137 uint32_t mask =
6138 static_cast<uint32_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(_mm256_or_si256(
6139 _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq), _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs))));
6140 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(mask != 0)) {
6141 p += __builtin_ctz(mask);
6142 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*p == '"'))
6143 return p;
6144 p += 2;
6145 continue;
6146 }
6147 p += 32;
6148 }
6149 }
6150 // SSE2 16B tail
6151 {
6152 const __m128i vq128 = _mm_set1_epi8('"');
6153 const __m128i vbs128 = _mm_set1_epi8('\\');
6154 while (p + 16 <= end_) {
6155 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
6156 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(
6157 _mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq128), _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs128)));
6158 if (mask) {
6159 p += __builtin_ctz(mask);
6160 if (*p == '"')
6161 return p;
6162 p += 2;
6163 break;
6164 }
6165 p += 16;
6166 }
6167 }
6168 // Scalar tail (platform-agnostic, handles last <16B)
6169 while (p < end_) {
6170 p = scan_string_end(p);
6171 if (p >= end_)
6172 return end_;
6173 if (*p == '"')
6174 return p;
6175 p += 2;
6176 }
6177 return p;
6178 }
6179#endif // QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
6180
6181 // Fused key scanner: scan string end, then consume ':' immediately.
6182 // For object keys: after closing '"', the next structural char is always
6183 // ':'. If the char after '"' is already ':', consume it and return the
6184 // next char. If there's whitespace between '"' and ':', do a normal SWAR
6185 // skip. Returns the char that follows the ':' (the start of the value, or
6186 // 0 on error). Also sets p_ to the position of that char.
6187 //
6188 // upgrade: SWAR-24 fast path (same as main switch case '"':)
6189 // covers ≤24-byte keys with no backslash, accounting for 90%+ of
6190 // twitter.json keys.
6191 QBUEM_INLINE char scan_key_colon_next(const char *s,
6192 const char **key_end_out) noexcept {
6193 // s is the char after the opening '"' of the key.
6194 const char *e;
6195 // NOTE: the former KeyLenCache "O(1) key-end" fast path was REMOVED — it
6196 // was unsound. It assumed sibling objects at the same depth share per-index
6197 // key lengths and validated a guess with `s[cl]=='"' && s[cl+1]==':'`, but
6198 // when a real key is shorter than the cached length cl, that pattern can
6199 // match coincidentally inside the value, mis-detecting the key boundary and
6200 // mis-parsing valid JSON. This silently corrupted heterogeneous objects
6201 // (e.g. compact twitter.json: `user` then `retweeted_status` siblings).
6202 // There is no sound O(1) check, so the SIMD/SWAR key scan below is always
6203 // used.
6204#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX2
6205#if QBUEM_HAS_AVX512
6206 // ── AVX-512 64B one-shot key scan
6207 // ───────────────────────────── Handles keys ≤63 chars in one 512-bit
6208 // operation.
6209 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 64 <= end_)) {
6210 const __m512i _vq512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('"');
6211 const __m512i _vbs512 = _mm512_set1_epi8('\\');
6212 __m512i _v512 = _mm512_loadu_si512(reinterpret_cast<const __m512i *>(s));
6213 uint64_t _mask512 = _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(_v512, _vq512) |
6214 _mm512_cmpeq_epi8_mask(_v512, _vbs512);
6215 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(_mask512 != 0)) {
6216 e = s + __builtin_ctzll(_mask512);
6217 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"')) {
6218 goto skn_found;
6219 }
6220 goto skn_slow; // backslash → full scanner
6221 }
6222 // mask==0: bytes [s, s+64) clean → skip_string_from64
6223 e = skip_string_from64(s);
6224 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6225 return 0;
6226 goto skn_found;
6227 }
6228 // s+64 > end_: fall through to AVX2 32B
6229#endif
6230 // ── AVX2 32B key scan
6231 // ───────────────────────────────────────── Handles keys ≤31 chars in
6232 // one 256-bit operation. mask==0 or backslash → goto skn_slow directly
6233 // (no SWAR-24 redundancy).
6234 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 32 <= end_)) {
6235 const __m256i _vq = _mm256_set1_epi8('"');
6236 const __m256i _vbs = _mm256_set1_epi8('\\');
6237 __m256i _v = _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i *>(s));
6238 uint32_t _mask =
6239 static_cast<uint32_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(_mm256_or_si256(
6240 _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(_v, _vq), _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(_v, _vbs))));
6241 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(_mask != 0)) {
6242 e = s + __builtin_ctz(_mask);
6243 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"')) {
6244 goto skn_found;
6245 }
6246 goto skn_slow; // backslash → full scanner
6247 }
6248 // ── mask==0 — bytes [s, s+32) are clean ────────────────
6249 // skip_string_from32 starts AVX2 at s+32 directly, skipping
6250 // scan_string_end's SWAR-8 gate (~11 instructions saved per call).
6251 e = skip_string_from32(s);
6252 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6253 return 0;
6254 goto skn_found;
6255 }
6256 // ── near end of buffer on AVX2+ → skn_slow directly
6257 // ────────── SWAR-24 is dead code on AVX2/AVX-512 machines (only
6258 // reached for keys within the last 31B of input, i.e. essentially never
6259 // on real files). Removing it shrinks the function → better L1 I-cache
6260 // utilization.
6261 goto skn_slow;
6262#elif QBUEM_HAS_NEON
6263#if defined(QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON)
6264 // ── / 65-M1: Apple Silicon 3×16B NEON key scanner ────────────
6265 // M1/M2/M3 characteristics that enable this extension:
6266 // - 128B L1/L2 cache lines: 3×16B loads (48B) still within one cache line
6267 // on aligned access → 3rd load is effectively free after the 1st miss.
6268 // - 576-entry ROB: wider speculative window absorbs the extra branch vs
6269 // generic ARM64 (~200 ROB entries) where showed +5.6%
6270 // regression.
6271 // - Pure NEON: no scalar pre-gates; all loads are vector instructions.
6272 //
6273 // Key-length distribution for benchmark files:
6274 // twitter.json : most keys ≤16B → v1 hit in hot path (same as 2×16B)
6275 // citm_catalog : keys up to ~20B → v1/v2 hit; v3 rarely needed
6276 // gsoc-2018.json: some keys 30-50B → v3 saves skip_string rescan
6277 //
6278 // For keys >48B (all 3 clean): skip_string(s+48) avoids rescanning 48B.
6279 // For keys 32-48B (v1+v2 clean, gate fails): fall to 2×16B path below.
6280 // For keys ≤32B (common case): identical hot path to the 2×16B baseline.
6281 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 48 <= end_)) {
6282 const uint8x16_t vq = vdupq_n_u8('"');
6283 const uint8x16_t vbs = vdupq_n_u8('\\');
6284
6285 uint8x16_t v1 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s));
6286 uint8x16_t m1 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v1, vq), vceqq_u8(v1, vbs));
6287 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m1)) != 0)) {
6288 e = s;
6289 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6290 ++e;
6291 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6292 goto skn_found;
6293 goto skn_slow;
6294 }
6295
6296 uint8x16_t v2 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s + 16));
6297 uint8x16_t m2 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v2, vq), vceqq_u8(v2, vbs));
6298 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m2)) != 0)) {
6299 e = s + 16;
6300 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6301 ++e;
6302 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6303 goto skn_found;
6304 goto skn_slow;
6305 }
6306
6307 uint8x16_t v3 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s + 32));
6308 uint8x16_t m3 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v3, vq), vceqq_u8(v3, vbs));
6309 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m3)) != 0)) {
6310 e = s + 32;
6311 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6312 ++e;
6313 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6314 goto skn_found;
6315 goto skn_slow;
6316 }
6317
6318 // [s, s+48) confirmed clean — skip_string(s+48) bypasses rescanning
6319 e = skip_string(s + 48);
6320 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6321 return 0; // malformed
6322 goto skn_found;
6323 }
6324 // 32 ≤ remaining < 48: 2×16B with skip_string(s+32) bypass
6325 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 32 <= end_)) {
6326 const uint8x16_t vq = vdupq_n_u8('"');
6327 const uint8x16_t vbs = vdupq_n_u8('\\');
6328
6329 uint8x16_t v1 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s));
6330 uint8x16_t m1 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v1, vq), vceqq_u8(v1, vbs));
6331 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m1)) != 0)) {
6332 e = s;
6333 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6334 ++e;
6335 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6336 goto skn_found;
6337 goto skn_slow;
6338 }
6339
6340 uint8x16_t v2 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s + 16));
6341 uint8x16_t m2 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v2, vq), vceqq_u8(v2, vbs));
6342 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m2)) != 0)) {
6343 e = s + 16;
6344 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6345 ++e;
6346 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6347 goto skn_found;
6348 goto skn_slow;
6349 }
6350
6351 // [s, s+32) clean → continue from s+32 (avoids rescanning via skn_slow)
6352 e = skip_string(s + 32);
6353 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6354 return 0; // malformed
6355 goto skn_found;
6356 }
6357 goto skn_slow;
6358#else
6359 // ── Generic AArch64 Pure NEON 2×16B ────────────────────────────
6360 // NEON vectorization outperforms scalar SWAR-24 globally across all AArch64
6361 // generic ARM64 due to wide vector pipelines.
6362 //
6363 // Cycle Latency & ILP Analysis vs SWAR:
6364 // 1. SWAR GPR: ldr(8B) -> eor -> sub -> bic -> and
6365 // Dependencies: 4 serial Integer ALU ops. Critical path: ~4-5 cycles/8B.
6366 // 2. NEON SIMD: vld1q(16B) -> vceqq -> vmaxvq
6367 // Dependencies: 2 Vector ALU ops. Critical path: ~5-6 cycles/16B.
6368 //
6369 // result (ARM64 pinned, 500 iter):
6370 // Pure NEON baseline: 243.7 μs
6371 // + 8B scalar while pre-scan: 257.5 μs (+5.6% regression)
6372 // Root cause: branch dependency stalls NEON pipeline in ~200-entry ROB.
6373 // → Do NOT add scalar pre-gates here; keep purely vectorised.
6374 //
6375 // when both 16B checks are clean (key >32B), call
6376 // skip_string(s+32) instead of goto skn_slow to avoid rescanning [s,s+32).
6377 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 32 <= end_)) {
6378 const uint8x16_t vq = vdupq_n_u8('"');
6379 const uint8x16_t vbs = vdupq_n_u8('\\');
6380
6381 uint8x16_t v1 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s));
6382 uint8x16_t m1 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v1, vq), vceqq_u8(v1, vbs));
6383 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m1)) != 0)) {
6384 e = s;
6385 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6386 ++e;
6387 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6388 goto skn_found;
6389 goto skn_slow;
6390 }
6391
6392 uint8x16_t v2 = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(s + 16));
6393 uint8x16_t m2 = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v2, vq), vceqq_u8(v2, vbs));
6394 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(vmaxvq_u32(vreinterpretq_u32_u8(m2)) != 0)) {
6395 e = s + 16;
6396 while (*e != '"' && *e != '\\')
6397 ++e;
6398 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(*e == '"'))
6399 goto skn_found;
6400 goto skn_slow;
6401 }
6402
6403 // [s, s+32) confirmed clean — skip_string(s+32) avoids rescanning
6404 e = skip_string(s + 32);
6405 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6406 return 0; // malformed
6407 goto skn_found;
6408 }
6409 goto skn_slow;
6410#endif // QBUEM_ARCH_APPLE_SILICON vs generic AArch64
6411#else
6412 // ── SWAR-24 (non-SIMD fallback: no AVX2, no NEON) ───────────────────────
6413 // finding: On Apple Silicon, this scalar SWAR path is faster
6414 // than NEON for short keys due to massive OoO windows and fast predictors.
6415 // load v0 first; exit immediately for ≤8-char keys (most common
6416 // twitter.json keys: "id", "text", "user", "lang" etc.) before loading
6417 // v1/v2.
6418 {
6419 constexpr uint64_t K = 0x0101010101010101ULL;
6420 constexpr uint64_t H = 0x8080808080808080ULL;
6421 const uint64_t qm = K * static_cast<uint8_t>('"');
6422 const uint64_t bsm = K * static_cast<uint8_t>('\\');
6423 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(s + 24 <= end_)) {
6424 uint64_t v0;
6425 std::memcpy(&v0, s, 8);
6426 uint64_t hq0 = v0 ^ qm;
6427 hq0 = (hq0 - K) & ~hq0 & H;
6428 uint64_t hb0 = v0 ^ bsm;
6429 hb0 = (hb0 - K) & ~hb0 & H;
6430 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(!hb0)) {
6431 if (hq0) { // ≤8-char key: quote in first chunk, no backslash
6432 e = s + (QBUEM_CTZ(hq0) >> 3);
6433 goto skn_found;
6434 }
6435 // Key is 9-24 chars: load v1 and v2
6436 uint64_t v1, v2;
6437 std::memcpy(&v1, s + 8, 8);
6438 std::memcpy(&v2, s + 16, 8);
6439 uint64_t hq1 = v1 ^ qm;
6440 hq1 = (hq1 - K) & ~hq1 & H;
6441 uint64_t hb1 = v1 ^ bsm;
6442 hb1 = (hb1 - K) & ~hb1 & H;
6443 uint64_t hq2 = v2 ^ qm;
6444 hq2 = (hq2 - K) & ~hq2 & H;
6445 uint64_t hb2 = v2 ^ bsm;
6446 hb2 = (hb2 - K) & ~hb2 & H;
6447 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(!(hb1 | hb2))) {
6448 if (hq1)
6449 e = s + 8 + (QBUEM_CTZ(hq1) >> 3);
6450 else if (hq2)
6451 e = s + 16 + (QBUEM_CTZ(hq2) >> 3);
6452 else
6453 goto skn_slow;
6454 goto skn_found;
6455 }
6456 }
6457 // Backslash found → fall through to full scan
6458 }
6459 } // end SWAR-24 scope (K/H/qm/bsm)
6460#endif // QBUEM_HAS_AVX2
6461 skn_slow:
6462 e = skip_string(s);
6463 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(e >= end_ || *e != '"'))
6464 return 0; // malformed
6465 skn_found:
6466 // Reject keys longer than the 16-bit length field.
6467 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(static_cast<size_t>(e - s) > 0xFFFFu))
6468 return 0;
6469 if (key_end_out)
6470 *key_end_out = e;
6471 push(TapeNodeType::StringRaw, static_cast<uint16_t>(e - s),
6472 static_cast<uint32_t>(s - data_));
6473 p_ = e + 1; // advance past closing '"'
6474
6475 // Now: consume ':' and skip whitespace to the value start.
6476 // Common case: p_ is already on ':' (no space between key and colon)
6477 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ < end_ && *p_ == ':')) {
6478 ++p_;
6479 // peek at value start
6480 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ < end_)) {
6481 unsigned char nc = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_);
6482 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(nc > 0x20))
6483 return static_cast<char>(nc);
6484 return skip_to_action();
6485 }
6486 return 0;
6487 }
6488 // Rare: whitespace between key and colon, or missing colon
6489 char ch = skip_to_action();
6490 if (ch != ':')
6491 return ch; // let outer loop handle it
6492 ++p_;
6493 return skip_to_action();
6494 }
6495
6496 // ── Technique 8: tape push via local register pointer ─
6497 // tape_head_ is kept in a CPU register across the parse() body.
6498 // No pointer chain: doc_->tape.head is only synced at the very end.
6499 // push(): for every token EXCEPT ObjectEnd/ArrayEnd.
6500 // Computes separator flag from current parse context, stores in meta bits
6501 // 23-16 so dump() needs no bit-stack at all.
6502 // sep = 0 → no separator (root, first array element, first object
6503 // key) sep = 1 → comma (non-first array element or object key)
6504 // sep = 2 → colon (object value, always)
6505 QBUEM_INLINE void push(TapeNodeType t, uint16_t l, uint32_t o) noexcept {
6506 // prefetch tape write slot 16 TapeNodes (192B) ahead — store
6507 // hint. Hides tape-arena write latency; significant gain on large files
6508 // (canada).
6509 __builtin_prefetch(tape_head_ + 16, 1, 1);
6510 uint8_t sep = 0;
6511 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(depth_ > 0)) {
6512 // (x86_64): LUT-based sep+state computation.
6513 // Replaces 14-instruction bit arithmetic with 2 table loads.
6514 // Valid states: 0(arr,no-elem), 3(obj,key,no-elem), 4(arr,has-elem),
6515 // 6(obj,val), 7(obj,key,has-elem).
6516 // sep_lut maps cur_state_ → separator byte (0=none, 1=comma, 2=colon)
6517 // ncs_lut maps cur_state_ → next cur_state_ after this push()
6518 // Both tables fit in a single 8-byte pair (trivially L1-resident).
6519 static constexpr uint8_t sep_lut[8] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, 1};
6520 // ncs_lut[cs] = next cur_state_ after push():
6521 // 000(0)→100(4): arr, gains has_elem
6522 // 011(3)→110(6): obj key (no-elem) → obj val (has-elem)
6523 // 100(4)→100(4): arr, has_elem stays
6524 // 110(6)→111(7): obj val → obj key (has-elem)
6525 // 111(7)→110(6): obj key → obj val
6526 static constexpr uint8_t ncs_lut[8] = {4, 0, 0, 6, 4, 0, 7, 6};
6527 const uint8_t cs = cur_state_;
6528 sep = sep_lut[cs];
6529 cur_state_ = ncs_lut[cs];
6530 }
6531 TapeNode *n = tape_head_++;
6532 n->meta = (static_cast<uint32_t>(t) << 24) |
6533 (static_cast<uint32_t>(sep) << 16) | static_cast<uint32_t>(l);
6534 n->offset = o;
6535 }
6536
6537 // push_end(): for ObjectEnd / ArrayEnd — always sep=0, no state update.
6538 QBUEM_INLINE void push_end(TapeNodeType t, uint32_t o) noexcept {
6539 TapeNode *n = tape_head_++;
6540 n->meta = static_cast<uint32_t>(t) << 24; // sep=0, len=0
6541 n->offset = o;
6542 }
6543
6544 QBUEM_INLINE uint32_t tape_size() const noexcept {
6545 return static_cast<uint32_t>(tape_head_ - doc_->tape.base);
6546 }
6547
6548public:
6549 explicit Parser(DocumentState *doc)
6550 : p_(doc->source.data()), end_(doc->source.data() + doc->source.size()),
6551 data_(doc->source.data()), doc_(doc),
6552 tape_head_(doc->tape.base) // initialize local head from arena base
6553 {}
6554
6555 // ── main parse loop ──────────────────────────────
6556 // Key changes vs :
6557 // 1. char c = skip_to_action() → switch(c) avoids re-read of *p_
6558 // 2. tape_head_ is local → no doc_->tape.size() pointer chain
6559 QBUEM_INLINE const char *get_p() const noexcept { return p_; }
6560 [[gnu::hot, gnu::flatten]] bool parse(bool allow_trailing = false) {
6561 // skip_to_action() returns the first action char AND advances p_.
6562 // We keep 'c' as the dispatch value — no *p_ re-read needed.
6563 char c = skip_to_action();
6564 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(c == 0)) {
6565 doc_->tape.head = tape_head_; // sync
6566 return false;
6567 }
6568
6569 while (p_ < end_) {
6570 // / Apple Silicon: prefetch QBUEM_PREFETCH_DISTANCE bytes
6571 // ahead with L2 locality hint. Distance is arch-tuned at compile time:
6572 // Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3): 512B (4 × 128B cache lines)
6573 // Generic ARM64: 256B (4 × 64B; winner)
6574 // x86_64: 192B
6575 QBUEM_PREFETCH(p_ + QBUEM_PREFETCH_DISTANCE);
6576 // LUT dispatch — 11 ActionId cases vs 17 raw char cases.
6577 // kActionLut[c] maps every byte to an ActionId in one L1 cache
6578 // access.
6579 switch (static_cast<ActionId>(kActionLut[static_cast<uint8_t>(c)])) {
6580
6581 case kActObjOpen: {
6582 // Nested objects/arrays are not valid object keys (RFC 8259 §4).
6583 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(cur_state_ & 0b001u))
6584 goto fail;
6585 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(depth_ >= kMaxDepth))
6586 goto fail;
6587 push(TapeNodeType::ObjectStart, 0, static_cast<uint32_t>(p_ - data_));
6588 // save parent state, init new object context.
6589 // cstate_stack_[depth_] saves cur_state_ for restore on close.
6590 cstate_stack_[depth_] = cur_state_;
6591 cur_state_ = 0b011u; // in_obj=1, is_key=1, has_elem=0
6592 ++depth_;
6593 ++p_;
6594 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ < end_)) {
6595 unsigned char fc = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_);
6596 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(fc > 0x20)) {
6597 c = static_cast<char>(fc);
6598 continue;
6599 }
6600 }
6601 break;
6602 }
6603 case kActArrOpen: {
6604 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(cur_state_ & 0b001u))
6605 goto fail;
6606 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(depth_ >= kMaxDepth))
6607 goto fail;
6608 push(TapeNodeType::ArrayStart, 0, static_cast<uint32_t>(p_ - data_));
6609 // save parent state, init new array context.
6610 cstate_stack_[depth_] = cur_state_;
6611 cur_state_ = 0b000u; // in_obj=0, is_key=0, has_elem=0
6612 ++depth_;
6613 ++p_;
6614 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(p_ < end_)) {
6615 unsigned char fc = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p_);
6616 if (QBUEM_LIKELY(fc > 0x20)) {
6617 c = static_cast<char>(fc);
6618 continue;
6619 }
6620 }
6621 break;
6622 }
6623 case kActClose: {
6624 if (QBUEM_UNLIKELY(depth_ == 0))
6625 goto fail;
6626 --depth_;
6627 // restore parent depth's state (no mask arithmetic).
6628 cur_state_ = cstate_stack_[depth_];
6629 push_end(c == '}' ? TapeNodeType::ObjectEnd : TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd,
6630 static_cast<uint32_t>(p_ - data_));
6631 ++p_;
6632 break;
6633 }

6688 e = s + __builtin_ctz(_mask);

6691 static_cast<uint32_t>(s - data_));

6694 }

6732 }

6734 }

6787 hb1 = (hb1 - K) & ~hb1 & H;

6804 }
6805 }

6807 uint64_t v;

6949 nc = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);

6960 goto done;
6961 }

6967 goto done;

6975 }

6978 goto done;
6979 continue;

6988 : TapeNodeType::ArrayEnd,

6999 case kActComma:

7011 // Replaces SWAR-8 (8B/iter) with NEON (16B/iter) on AArch64.
7012 // canada.json: integer parts are short (1-5 digits) → minimal gain
7013 // but consistent with the fractional-part NEON approach below.

7059 ++p_;

7063 // NEON-16: 1 iteration/float (14B in 16B chunk) = 8 ops/float.
7064 // twitter.json: small floats → mostly scalar tail (no change).

7083 while (p_ + 16 <= end_) { \
