10254namespace json::detail {
10255
10256QBUEM_INLINE void ws(const char *&p, const char *end) noexcept {
10257 // Fast-path for compact JSON (no whitespace between tokens — by far the common case)
10258 if (p >= end || (unsigned char)*p > 32) [[likely]] return;
10259 do { ++p; } while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32);
10260}
10261
10262struct NexusScanner {
10263 const char *p;
10264 const char *end;
10265 const char *begin = nullptr; // optional: set by fuse()/fuse_strict() for offset reporting
10266 // Raw bytes of the most recent key scanned by read_key_h(); used to verify
10267 // the hash-dispatch match against the actual field name (the hash alone is
10268 // collision-prone, which would let an attacker route an untrusted key into
10269 // the wrong struct field — field spoofing / type confusion).
10270 std::string_view last_key_{};
10271
10272 QBUEM_INLINE void ws() noexcept { detail::ws(p, end); }
10273
10274 // ── read_key: backward-compat, returns string_view ─────────────────────────
10275 QBUEM_INLINE std::string_view read_key() noexcept {
10276 ws();
10277 if (p >= end || *p != '"') [[unlikely]] return {};
10278 const char *start = ++p;
10279 // SIMD fast scan (16 bytes/iter)
10280#if defined(QBUEM_ARCH_X86_64)
10281 while (p + 16 <= end) {
10282 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
10283 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_or_si128(
10284 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, _mm_set1_epi8('"')),
10285 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, _mm_set1_epi8('\\'))));
10286 if (!mask) { p += 16; continue; }
10287 p += __builtin_ctz(mask); break;
10288 }
10289#elif QBUEM_HAS_NEON
10290 while (p + 16 <= end) {
10291 uint8x16_t v = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(p));
10292 uint8x16_t need = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v, vdupq_n_u8('"')),
10293 vceqq_u8(v, vdupq_n_u8('\\')));
10294 uint64_t lo = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 0);
10295 uint64_t hi = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 1);
10296 if (!(lo | hi)) { p += 16; continue; }
10297 p += lo ? (__builtin_ctzll(lo) >> 3) : (8 + (__builtin_ctzll(hi) >> 3));
10298 break;
10299 }
10300#endif
10301 // SWAR-8 for remaining bytes
10302 while (p + 8 <= end) {
10303 uint64_t w; std::memcpy(&w, p, 8);
10304 uint64_t qm = w ^ 0x2222222222222222ULL;
10305 uint64_t mq = (qm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~qm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10306 uint64_t bm = w ^ 0x5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5cULL;
10307 uint64_t mb = (bm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~bm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10308 if ((mq | mb) == 0) { p += 8; continue; }
10309 break;
10310 }
10311 while (p < end && *p != '"') {
10312 if (*p == '\\') [[unlikely]] {
10313 if (p + 1 < end) [[likely]] p += 2;
10314 else { p = end; break; }
10315 } else {
10316 ++p;
10317 }
10318 }
10319 std::string_view key(start, static_cast<size_t>(p - start));
10320 if (p < end) ++p;
10321 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10322 if (p < end && *p == ':') [[likely]] ++p;
10323 return key;
10324 }
10325
10326 // ── read_key_h: scan key AND compute fast_key_hash in one pass ─────────────
10327 // For keys ≤8 bytes with no escape sequences (the overwhelming common case for
10328 // struct fields), the hash falls out of the SWAR termination word — zero extra
10329 // work vs the existing scan.
10330 QBUEM_INLINE uint64_t read_key_h() noexcept {
10331 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10332 if (p >= end || *p != '"') [[unlikely]] return 0;
10333 const char *start = ++p;
10334
10335 // ── Hot path: key ≤8 bytes, no escape ──────────────────────────────────
10336 if (p + 8 <= end) [[likely]] {
10337 uint64_t w; std::memcpy(&w, p, 8);
10338 uint64_t qm = w ^ 0x2222222222222222ULL;
10339 uint64_t mq = (qm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~qm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10340 if (mq) [[likely]] {
10341 uint64_t bm = w ^ 0x5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5cULL;
10342 uint64_t mb = (bm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~bm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10343 if (!mb) [[likely]] {
10344 // Quote found within 8 bytes, no backslash — key fits in one word
10345 const int bp = static_cast<int>(__builtin_ctzll(mq) >> 3); // byte pos of '"'
10346 p += bp + 1; // skip key + '"'
10347 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10348 if (p < end && *p == ':') [[likely]] ++p;
10349 // Hash = raw bytes [0..bp-1], zero-padded — identical to fast_key_hash_ce
10350 const uint64_t mask = bp ? ((uint64_t(1) << (bp * 8)) - 1) : uint64_t(0);
10351 last_key_ = std::string_view(start, static_cast<size_t>(bp));
10352 return w & mask;
10353 }
10354 }
10355 }
10356
10357 // ── General path: key >8 bytes or contains escape sequences ────────────
10358#if defined(QBUEM_ARCH_X86_64)
10359 while (p + 16 <= end) {
10360 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(p));
10361 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_or_si128(
10362 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, _mm_set1_epi8('"')),
10363 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, _mm_set1_epi8('\\'))));
10364 if (!mask) { p += 16; continue; }
10365 p += __builtin_ctz(mask); break;
10366 }
10367#elif QBUEM_HAS_NEON
10368 while (p + 16 <= end) {
10369 uint8x16_t v = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(p));
10370 uint8x16_t need = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v, vdupq_n_u8('"')),
10371 vceqq_u8(v, vdupq_n_u8('\\')));
10372 uint64_t lo = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 0);
10373 uint64_t hi = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 1);
10374 if (!(lo | hi)) { p += 16; continue; }
10375 p += lo ? (__builtin_ctzll(lo) >> 3) : (8 + (__builtin_ctzll(hi) >> 3));
10376 break;
10377 }
10378#endif
10379 while (p + 8 <= end) {
10380 uint64_t w; std::memcpy(&w, p, 8);
10381 uint64_t qm = w ^ 0x2222222222222222ULL;
10382 uint64_t mq = (qm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~qm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10383 uint64_t bm = w ^ 0x5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5cULL;
10384 uint64_t mb = (bm - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~bm & 0x8080808080808080ULL;
10385 if ((mq | mb) == 0) { p += 8; continue; }
10386 break;
10387 }
10388 while (p < end && *p != '"') {
10389 if (*p == '\\') [[unlikely]] {
10390 if (p + 1 < end) [[likely]] p += 2;
10391 else { p = end; break; }
10392 } else {
10393 ++p;
10394 }
10395 }
10396 const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(p - start);
10397 if (p < end) ++p;
10398 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10399 if (p < end && *p == ':') [[likely]] ++p;
10400 last_key_ = std::string_view{start, n};
10401 return detail::fast_key_hash(std::string_view{start, n});
10402 }
10403
10404 template <typename T> inline void fill(T &obj);
10405};
10406
10407template <typename T> void from_json_direct(const char *&p, const char *end, T &out);
10408
10409QBUEM_COLD inline void skip_direct(const char *&p, const char *end) {
10410 rfc8259::detail_::Validator v;
10411 v.p = p; v.end = end; v.begin = p;
10412 try { v.parse_value(); p = v.p; } catch (...) { p = end; }
10413}
10414
10415// ── Nexus diagnostic helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
10416// nexus_strict_mode() — returns a reference to the thread-local strict-mode
10417// flag. When true, from_json_direct throws on type mismatches instead of
10418// silently skipping.
10419//
10420// Two ways to enable:
10421// 1. Compile-time: define QBUEM_NEXUS_STRICT before including this header.
10422// The flag is permanently true; fuse() and fuse_strict() behave the same.
10423// 2. Runtime: call fuse_strict<T>() which sets/clears the flag around a
10424// single deserialization call. Zero overhead on the non-strict path.
10425inline bool &nexus_strict_mode() noexcept {
10426#ifdef QBUEM_NEXUS_STRICT
10427 // Compile-time strict: return a reference to a permanently-true thread-local.
10428 static thread_local bool always_true = true;
10429 return always_true;
10430#else
10431 thread_local bool flag = false;
10432 return flag;
10433#endif
10434}
10435
10436// Nexus recursion-depth bound. The typed from_json_direct path recurses through
10437// nested structs / Optional / Map / Tuple / Seq with no cap; a recursive-typed
10438// schema (e.g. a tree node) fed deeply-nested untrusted JSON would exhaust the
10439// native stack (SIGSEGV). skip_direct is already bounded via the Validator;
10440// this RAII guard bounds the typed path to the same depth. Only the recursive
10441// branches construct it, so scalar fields pay nothing.
10442inline int &nexus_depth() noexcept {
10443 thread_local int d = 0;
10444 return d;
10445}
10446struct NexusDepthGuard {
10447 static constexpr int kMax = 1024;
10448 NexusDepthGuard() {
10449 if (++nexus_depth() > kMax) {
10450 --nexus_depth();
10451 throw std::runtime_error("Nexus: input nesting too deep");
10452 }
10453 }
10454 ~NexusDepthGuard() { --nexus_depth(); }
10455};
10456
10457// peek_json_type: returns a human-readable label for the JSON token at *p.
10458// Used in Nexus error messages so callers see "expected number, got string"
10459// instead of a raw type tag or a silent skip.
10460QBUEM_COLD inline const char *peek_json_type(const char *p, const char *end) noexcept {
10461 if (p >= end) return "end-of-input";
10462 switch (static_cast<unsigned char>(*p)) {
10463 case '{': return "object";
10464 case '[': return "array";
10465 case '"': return "string";
10466 case 't': case 'f': return "boolean";
10467 case 'n': return "null";
10468 case '-':
10469 case '0': case '1': case '2': case '3': case '4':
10470 case '5': case '6': case '7': case '8': case '9': return "number";
10471 default: return "unknown token";
10472 }
10473}
10474
10475// nexus_type_error: build and throw a runtime_error describing a Nexus type
10476// mismatch. |expected| is the C++ side expectation, |p| points to the
10477// offending JSON token, |begin| (may be nullptr) enables byte-offset reporting.
10478[[noreturn]] QBUEM_COLD inline void nexus_type_error(
10479 const char *expected, const char *p, const char *end,
10480 const char *begin = nullptr)
10481{
10482 char buf[160];
10483 const char *got = peek_json_type(p, end);
10484 if (begin) {
10485 const std::ptrdiff_t off = p - begin;
10486 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
10487 "Nexus: expected %s, got %s at byte offset %td",
10488 expected, got, off);
10489 } else {
10490 std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
10491 "Nexus: expected %s, got %s",
10492 expected, got);
10493 }
10494 throw std::runtime_error(buf);
10495}
10496
10497template <typename T> void from_json_direct(const char *&p, const char *end, T &out) {
10498 if (p >= end) return;
10499 if constexpr (HasNexusPulse<T>) {
10500 NexusDepthGuard _g; // bound recursion (nested struct)
10501 NexusScanner scanner{p, end};
10502 scanner.fill(out);
10503 p = scanner.p;
10504 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailBool<T>) {
10505 while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p;
10506 if (p + 4 <= end && !std::memcmp(p, "true", 4)) { out = true; p += 4; }
10507 else if (p + 5 <= end && !std::memcmp(p, "false", 5)) { out = false; p += 5; }
10508 else {
10509 if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("boolean", p, end);
10510 else skip_direct(p, end);
10511 }
10512 } else if constexpr (std::is_enum_v<T>) {
10513 if constexpr (JsonDetailStringEnum<T>) {
10514 std::string tmp;
10515 from_json_direct(p, end, tmp); // reuse the std::string token reader
10516 T e{};
10517 if (qbuem_enum_from_string(tmp, e)) out = e;
10518 else if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("enum", p, end);
10519 } else {
10520 std::underlying_type_t<T> u{};
10521 from_json_direct(p, end, u); // reuse the integer reader
10522 out = static_cast<T>(u);
10523 }
10524 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailArith<T>) {
10525 while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p;
10526 // In strict mode, reject any non-number token before scanning digits.
10527 // Without this check, from_chars silently returns zero on type mismatches.
10528 if (nexus_strict_mode()) {
10529 const char c = p < end ? *p : '\0';
10530 const bool looks_numeric = (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-';
10531 if (!looks_numeric) nexus_type_error("number", p, end);
10532 }
10533 const char *start = p;
10534 while (p < end && ((*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') || *p == '-' || *p == '.' || *p == 'e' || *p == 'E' || *p == '+')) ++p;
10535 if (p == start) {
10536 // The value is not a number (type mismatch). Strict mode already threw
10537 // above; in relaxed mode the charset loop matched nothing, so p did not
10538 // advance — consume the actual token via skip_direct so the cursor stays
10539 // in sync. Without this the value's bytes are mis-read as the next key
10540 // and the rest of the object is silently dropped.
10541 skip_direct(p, end);
10542 return;
10543 }
10544 if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
10545 out = static_cast<T>(json::detail::qj_nc::parse_f64(start, p));
10546 } else {
10547 auto [_nxt, _ec] = std::from_chars(start, p, out);
10548 if (nexus_strict_mode() && _ec != std::errc{}) {
10549 throw std::runtime_error("Nexus: integer parse failed (overflow or unexpected digits)");
10550 }
10551 }
10552 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailOptional<T>) {
10553 NexusDepthGuard _g; // bound recursion
10554 detail::ws(p, end);
10555 if (p + 4 <= end && !std::memcmp(p, "null", 4)) {
10556 out = std::nullopt;
10557 p += 4;
10558 } else {
10559 typename T::value_type inner{};
10560 from_json_direct(p, end, inner);
10561 out = std::move(inner);
10562 }
10563 } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string>) {
10564 detail::ws(p, end);
10565 if (p < end && *p == '"') {
10566 const char *start = ++p;
10567 // Fast scan: find first '"' or '\'
10568 const char *safe = p;
10569#if defined(QBUEM_ARCH_X86_64)
10570 {
10571 const __m128i vq = _mm_set1_epi8('"');
10572 const __m128i vbs = _mm_set1_epi8('\\');
10573 while (safe + 16 <= end) {
10574 __m128i v = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(safe));
10575 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_or_si128(_mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vq),
10576 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(v, vbs)));
10577 if (!mask) { safe += 16; continue; }
10578 safe += __builtin_ctz(mask);
10579 break;
10580 }
10581 }
10582#elif defined(QBUEM_HAS_NEON)
10583 {
10584 const uint8x16_t vq = vdupq_n_u8('"');
10585 const uint8x16_t vbs = vdupq_n_u8('\\');
10586 while (safe + 16 <= end) {
10587 uint8x16_t v = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(safe));
10588 uint8x16_t need = vorrq_u8(vceqq_u8(v, vq), vceqq_u8(v, vbs));
10589 uint64_t lo = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 0);
10590 uint64_t hi = vgetq_lane_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(need), 1);
10591 if (!(lo | hi)) { safe += 16; continue; }
10592 safe += lo ? (__builtin_ctzll(lo) >> 3) : (8 + (__builtin_ctzll(hi) >> 3));
10593 break;
10594 }
10595 }
10596#endif
10597 // SWAR-8 fallback
10598 {
10599 const uint64_t kQ = UINT64_C(0x2222222222222222); // '"' * 0x0101...
10600 const uint64_t kBS = UINT64_C(0x5C5C5C5C5C5C5C5C); // '\\' * 0x0101...
10601 while (safe + 8 <= end) {
10602 uint64_t w; std::memcpy(&w, safe, 8);
10603 auto has_byte = [](uint64_t v, uint64_t b) -> uint64_t {
10604 uint64_t x = v ^ b;
10605 return (x - UINT64_C(0x0101010101010101)) & ~x & UINT64_C(0x8080808080808080);
10606 };
10607 if (uint64_t hit = has_byte(w, kQ) | has_byte(w, kBS)) {
10608 safe += __builtin_ctzll(hit) >> 3; break;
10609 }
10610 safe += 8;
10611 }
10612 }
10613 p = safe;
10614 // No-escape fast path
10615 if (p < end && *p == '"') {
10616 out.assign(start, p - start);
10617 ++p;
10618 } else {
10619 // Slow path: handle escape sequences. A trailing backslash (input
10620 // ending in '\') must NOT advance past end — "p += 2" there overruns
10621 // the buffer and out.assign() then reads out of bounds.
10622 while (p < end && *p != '"') {
10623 if (*p == '\\') {
10624 if (p + 1 < end) p += 2; // escape + escaped char
10625 else { p = end; break; } // dangling backslash at end of input
10626 } else {
10627 ++p;
10628 }
10629 }
10630 out.assign(start, p - start);
10631 if (p < end) ++p;
10632 }
10633 } else {
10634 if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("string", p, end);
10635 else skip_direct(p, end);
10636 }
10637 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailMap<T>) {
10638 NexusDepthGuard _g; // bound recursion
10639 out.clear();
10640 detail::ws(p, end);
10641 if (p < end && *p == '{') {
10642 ++p;
10643 detail::ws(p, end);
10644 while (p < end && *p != '}') {
10645 const char *before = p;
10646 std::string key;
10647 from_json_direct(p, end, key);
10648 detail::ws(p, end);
10649 if (p < end && *p == ':')
10650 ++p;
10651 detail::ws(p, end);
10652 typename T::mapped_type val{};
10653 from_json_direct(p, end, val);
10654 out.emplace(std::move(key), std::move(val));
10655 detail::ws(p, end);
10656 if (p < end && *p == ',') {
10657 ++p;
10658 detail::ws(p, end);
10659 }
10660 // Guarantee forward progress on un-consumable input (avoids an
10661 // infinite emplace loop → OOM).
10662 if (p == before) break;
10663 }
10664 if (p < end)
10665 ++p;
10666 } else {
10667 if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("object", p, end);
10668 else skip_direct(p, end);
10669 }
10670 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailTuple<T>) {
10671 NexusDepthGuard _g; // bound recursion
10672 detail::ws(p, end);
10673 if (p < end && *p == '[') {
10674 ++p;
10675 std::apply([&](auto &...args) {
10676 ((from_json_direct(p, end, args), detail::ws(p, end),
10677 (p < end && *p == ',' ? ++p : p), detail::ws(p, end)),
10678 ...);
10679 }, out);
10680 while (p < end && *p != ']')
10681 ++p;
10682 if (p < end)
10683 ++p;
10684 } else {
10685 if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("array", p, end);
10686 else skip_direct(p, end);
10687 }
10688 } else if constexpr (JsonDetailSeq<T>) {
10689 NexusDepthGuard _g; // bound recursion
10690 out.clear();
10691 while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p;
10692 if (p < end && *p == '[') {
10693 ++p; while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p;
10694 while (p < end && *p != ']') {
10695 const char *before = p;
10696 typename T::value_type item{};
10697 from_json_direct(p, end, item);
10698 out.push_back(std::move(item));
10699 while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p;
10700 if (p < end && *p == ',') { ++p; while (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) ++p; }
10701 // Guarantee forward progress: an un-consumable element (e.g. a '"' where
10702 // an int is expected) would otherwise spin forever, push_back-ing until
10703 // OOM (small input -> multi-GB vector).
10704 if (p == before) break;
10705 }
10706 if (p < end) ++p;
10707 } else {
10708 if (nexus_strict_mode()) nexus_type_error("array", p, end);
10709 else skip_direct(p, end);
10710 }
10711 } else if constexpr (ReflectableAggregate<T>) {
10712 // Macro-free nested aggregate: recurse via the same streaming fill (its keys
10713 // route through nexus_reflect_pulse_). Placed AFTER the container branches so
10714 // std::array / tuple / map — which are also aggregates — keep their specific
10715 // handling.
10716 NexusDepthGuard _g;
10717 NexusScanner scanner{p, end};
10718 scanner.fill(out);
10719 p = scanner.p;
10720 } else {
10721 skip_direct(p, end);
10722 }
10723}
10724
10725// Macro-free fuse dispatch: route a scanned key (already hashed by read_key_h) to
10726// the matching reflected field and stream its value straight into it. Mirrors the
10727// macro-generated nexus_pulse_h switch — hash match + byte verify, then
10728// from_json_direct — but built from refl primitives, so a plain aggregate needs no
10729// QBUEM_JSON_FIELDS. The ladder compares against compile-time field-name hashes (so
10730// GCC/Clang can fold it); for very wide hot-path structs the macro's switch is still
10731// the optimal dispatch.
10732template <typename T>
10733QBUEM_INLINE void nexus_reflect_pulse_(uint64_t h, ::std::string_view key,
10734 const char *&p, const char *end, T &obj) {
10735 auto _ptrs = refl::field_ptrs(obj);
10736 const bool _matched =
10737 [&]<::std::size_t... I>(::std::index_sequence<I...>) {
10738 return (((h == fast_key_hash_ce_sv(refl::field_name<T, I>()) &&
10739 key == refl::field_name<T, I>())
10740 ? (from_json_direct(p, end, *::std::get<I>(_ptrs)), true)
10741 : false) ||
10742 ...);
10743 }(::std::make_index_sequence<refl::field_count<T>()>{});
10744 if (!_matched) skip_direct(p, end);
10745}
10746
10747template <typename T> inline void NexusScanner::fill(T &obj) {
10748 ws();
10749 if (p >= end || *p != '{') [[unlikely]] {
10750 // Always throw here: passing a non-object root to Nexus fill() is a
10751 // programming error — the target C++ struct has no way to represent
10752 // anything other than a JSON object.
10753 nexus_type_error("object", p, end, begin);
10754 }
10755 ++p;
10756 if (p < end && *p == '}') [[unlikely]] { ++p; return; } // empty object
10757 ws();
10758 while (p < end && *p != '}') {
10759 if constexpr (HasNexusPulseH<T>) {
10760 // Fast path: hash computed during key scan — zero extra traversal
10761 const uint64_t h = read_key_h();
10762 nexus_pulse_h(h, last_key_, p, end, obj);
10763 } else if constexpr (HasNexusPulse<T>) {
10764 nexus_pulse(read_key(), p, end, obj);
10765 } else if constexpr (ReflectableAggregate<T>) {
10766 // Macro-free aggregate: same hash dispatch the macro would generate, built
10767 // from reflected field names instead of a QBUEM_JSON_FIELDS switch.
10768 const uint64_t h = read_key_h();
10769 nexus_reflect_pulse_(h, last_key_, p, end, obj);
10770 } else {
10771 static_assert(sizeof(T) == 0,
10772 "qbuem::fuse<T>: T must be registered with QBUEM_JSON_FIELDS, "
10773 "provide a manual nexus_pulse hook, or be a reflectable "
10774 "aggregate (GCC/Clang).");
10775 }
10776 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10777 if (p < end && *p == ',') [[likely]] { ++p; }
10778 if (p < end && (unsigned char)*p <= 32) [[unlikely]] ws();
10779 }
10780 if (p < end) ++p;
10781}

10785// read / write / fuse helpers
10786template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] T read(::std::string_view json) {
10787 Document doc;
10788 Value root = json::parse_reuse(doc, json);
10789 T obj{};
10790 ::qbuem::json::detail::from_json(root, obj);
10791 return obj;
10792}

10794// read_strict<T> — like read<T>, but a missing REQUIRED field throws
10795// qbuem::parse_error instead of silently leaving it default-constructed. For a
10796// reflectable aggregate, a member is "required" unless it is a std::optional;
10797// model optional request fields as std::optional<U>. Checks nest through
10798// aggregates and present optionals (so nested DTOs are validated); it does not
10799// reach into list/map elements. For renamed/registered structs use read<T> plus
10800// an explicit check — strict mode is reflection-driven.
10801// auto req = qbuem::read_strict<CreateUserReq>(body); // throws if "email" absent
10802template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] T read_strict(::std::string_view json) {
10803 static_assert(::qbuem::json::detail::ReflectableAggregate<T>,
10804 "qbuem::read_strict<T> requires a reflectable aggregate (a plain "
10805 "struct with no QBUEM_JSON_FIELDS). Use std::optional<U> for "
10806 "optional fields; non-optional fields are required.");
10807 Document doc;
10808 Value root = json::parse_reuse(doc, json);
10809 T obj{};
10810 ::qbuem::json::detail::from_json_strict(root, obj);
10811 return obj;
10812}

10814template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] T fuse(::std::string_view json) {
10815 T obj{};
10816 json::detail::NexusScanner scanner{json.data(), json.data() + json.size(), json.data()};
10817 scanner.fill(obj);
10818 return obj;
10819}

10837template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] T fuse_strict(::std::string_view json) {
10838 json::detail::nexus_strict_mode() = true;
10839 try {
10840 T obj{};
10841 json::detail::NexusScanner scanner{json.data(), json.data() + json.size(), json.data()};
10842 scanner.fill(obj);
10843 // Reject trailing content after the root object (matches parse_strict /
10844 // rfc8259::validate), so "{...}garbage" is an error in strict mode.
10845 scanner.ws();
10846 if (scanner.p != scanner.end)
10847 json::detail::nexus_type_error("end-of-input", scanner.p, scanner.end,
10848 json.data());
10849 json::detail::nexus_strict_mode() = false;
10850 return obj;
10851 } catch (...) {
10852 json::detail::nexus_strict_mode() = false;
10853 throw;
10854 }
10855}

10857template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] ::std::string write(const T &obj) {
10858 ::std::string out;
10859 out.reserve(512);
10860 ::qbuem::json::detail::append_json(out, obj);
10861 return out;

10864// write(obj, indent) — pretty-printed variant.
10865// Serializes obj to compact JSON, then re-parses and formats with indent spaces
10866// per level. Use write(obj) for hot paths; this variant is for human-readable output.
10867template <typename T> [[nodiscard]] ::std::string write(const T &obj, int indent) {
10868 ::std::string compact = write(obj);
10869 Document tmp;
10870 Value root = parse(tmp, compact);
10871 return root.dump(indent);
10872}

10874// write_to(buf, obj) — zero-allocation variant for hot loops.
10875// Appends the compact JSON representation of obj to an existing string buffer.
10876// Call buf.clear() between iterations; the buffer's heap capacity is reused.
10877template <typename T> void write_to(::std::string &buf, const T &obj) {
10878 ::qbuem::json::detail::append_json(buf, obj);
10879}
10880
10881// write_to(buf, obj, indent) — pretty-printed buffer-append variant.
10882template <typename T> void write_to(::std::string &buf, const T &obj, int indent) {
10883 ::std::string compact;
10884 compact.reserve(512);
10885 ::qbuem::json::detail::append_json(compact, obj);
10886 Document tmp;
10887 Value root = parse(tmp, compact);
10888 buf += root.dump(indent);
10889}
